                    $old = $wedding->{$field};
                    $wedding->{$field} = $request->file($field)->store('wedding/'.$wedding->id.'/'.$folder, 'public');
                    $this->deleteStoredFile($old);
                }
            }

            if ($request->hasFile('music')) {
                $this->deleteStoredFile($wedding->music_path);
                $wedding->music_path = $request->file('music')->store('wedding/'.$wedding->id.'/music', 'public');
            }

            $sections = config('wedding.default_sections');
            foreach (array_keys($sections) as $key) {
                $sections[$key] = (bool) ($data['sections'][$key] ?? false);
            }

            $wedding->fill(collect($data)->except([
                'sections', 'events', 'stories', 'gifts', 'photos', 'remove_photos', 'music', 'cover_photo',
                'groom_photo', 'bride_photo',
            ])->all());
            $wedding->sections = $sections;
            $wedding->save();

            $this->syncEvents($wedding, $request->input('events', []));
            $this->syncStories($wedding, $request->input('stories', []));
            $this->syncGifts($wedding, $request->input('gifts', []));
            $this->syncPhotos($request, $wedding);
        });

        if ($isAutosave) {
            return response()->json([
                'ok' => true,
                'message' => 'Perubahan tersimpan otomatis.',
                'updated_at' => now()->format('H:i:s'),
                'preview' => route('wedding.invitations.preview', $wedding),
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('wedding.invitations.edit', $wedding)
            ->with('status', 'Undangan berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function changeTemplate(Request $request, Wedding $wedding): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('update', $wedding);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'template_id' => ['required', Rule::exists('templates', 'id')->where('is_active', true)],
        ]);

        $wedding->update(['template_id' => $data['template_id']]);

        return back()->with('status', 'Desain undangan berhasil diganti.');
    }

    public function preview(Wedding $wedding)
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $wedding);

        $wedding->load(['template', 'events', 'stories', 'photos', 'gifts', 'wishes' => fn ($q) => $q->where('status', 'approved')->latest()]);
        $slug = $wedding->template?->slug ?? 'melati';
        abort_unless(view()->exists('wedding.templates.'.$slug.'.index'), 404);

        return response()
            ->view('wedding.templates.'.$slug.'.index', [
                'wedding' => $wedding,
                'recipientName' => 'Bapak/Ibu/Saudara/i',
                'guest' => null,
                'isPreview' => true,
                'previewMode' => true,
                'embed' => true,
            ])
            ->header('X-Robots-Tag', 'noindex, nofollow');
    }

    public function publish(Request $request, Wedding $wedding): RedirectResponse|JsonResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('publish', $wedding);

        $publishing = ! $wedding->isPublished();

        if ($publishing) {
            $wedding->loadCount('events');
            if ($wedding->events_count === 0) {
                $message = 'Tambahkan minimal satu rangkaian acara sebelum mempublikasikan undangan.';
                if ($request->expectsJson()) {
                    return response()->json(['ok' => false, 'message' => $message], 422);
                }

                return back()->withErrors(['publish' => $message]);
            }
        }

        $wedding->forceFill([
            'status' => $publishing ? Wedding::STATUS_PUBLISHED : Wedding::STATUS_DRAFT,
            'published_at' => $publishing ? now() : null,
        ])->save();

        if ($request->expectsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'ok' => true,
                'published' => $publishing,
                'message' => $publishing ? 'Undangan dipublikasikan.' : 'Undangan dikembalikan ke draf.',
            ]);
        }

        return back()->with('status', $publishing ? 'Undangan dipublikasikan.' : 'Undangan dikembalikan ke draf.');
    }

    public function duplicate(Wedding $wedding): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $wedding);
        $user = request()->user();

        if (! $user->canCreateInvitation()) {
            return back()->withErrors(['limit' => 'Batas undangan paket Anda sudah tercapai.']);
        }

        $copy = $wedding->replicate(['slug', 'views_count', 'published_at']);
        $copy->slug = $this->uniqueSlug($wedding->slug.'-copy');
        $copy->status = Wedding::STATUS_DRAFT;
        $copy->published_at = null;
        $copy->views_count = 0;
        $copy->save();

        foreach (['events', 'stories', 'gifts'] as $relation) {
            foreach ($wedding->{$relation} as $item) {
                $clone = $item->replicate();
                $clone->wedding_id = $copy->id;
                $clone->save();
            }
        }
        foreach ($wedding->photos as $photo) {
            $clone = $photo->replicate();
            $clone->wedding_id = $copy->id;
            $clone->save();
        }

        return redirect()->route('wedding.invitations.edit', $copy)
            ->with('status', 'Undangan diduplikasi sebagai draf baru.');
    }

    public function destroy(Wedding $wedding): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('delete', $wedding);
        $wedding->delete();
        Storage::disk('public')->deleteDirectory('wedding/'.$wedding->id);

        return redirect()->route('wedding.invitations.index')->with('status', 'Undangan dihapus.');
    }

    private function syncEvents(Wedding $wedding, array $rows): void
    {
        $kept = [];
        foreach (array_values($rows) as $i => $row) {
            if (empty($row['name'])) {
                continue;
            }
            $attrs = [
                'name' => $row['name'],
                'event_date' => $row['event_date'] ?? null,
                'start_time' => $row['start_time'] ?? null,
                'end_time' => $row['end_time'] ?? null,
                'venue_name' => $row['venue_name'] ?? null,
                'address' => $row['address'] ?? null,
                'maps_url' => $row['maps_url'] ?? null,
                'sort_order' => $i,
            ];
            $event = ! empty($row['id'])
                ? $wedding->events()->whereKey($row['id'])->first()
                : null;
            if ($event) {
                $event->update($attrs);
            } else {
                $event = $wedding->events()->create($attrs);
            }
            $kept[] = $event->id;
        }
        $wedding->events()->whereNotIn('id', $kept)->delete();
    }

    private function syncStories(Wedding $wedding, array $rows): void
    {
        $kept = [];
        foreach (array_values($rows) as $i => $row) {
            if (empty($row['title']) && empty($row['body'])) {
                continue;
            }
            $attrs = [
                'title' => $row['title'] ?? 'Momen',
                'story_date' => $row['story_date'] ?? null,
                'body' => $row['body'] ?? null,
                'sort_order' => $i,
            ];
            $story = ! empty($row['id']) ? $wedding->stories()->whereKey($row['id'])->first() : null;
            if ($story) {
                $story->update($attrs);
            } else {
                $story = $wedding->stories()->create($attrs);
            }
            $kept[] = $story->id;
        }
        $wedding->stories()->whereNotIn('id', $kept)->delete();
    }

    private function syncGifts(Wedding $wedding, array $rows): void
    {
        $kept = [];
        foreach (array_values($rows) as $i => $row) {
            if (empty($row['bank_name']) || empty($row['account_number'])) {
                continue;
            }
            $attrs = [
                'bank_name' => $row['bank_name'],
                'account_number' => $row['account_number'],
                'account_name' => $row['account_name'] ?? null,
                'sort_order' => $i,
            ];
            $gift = ! empty($row['id']) ? $wedding->gifts()->whereKey($row['id'])->first() : null;
            if ($gift) {
                $gift->update($attrs);
            } else {
                $gift = $wedding->gifts()->create($attrs);
            }
            $kept[] = $gift->id;
        }
        $wedding->gifts()->whereNotIn('id', $kept)->delete();
    }

    private function syncPhotos(Request $request, Wedding $wedding): void
    {
        $remove = array_filter((array) $request->input('remove_photos', []));
        if ($remove) {
            $photos = $wedding->photos()->whereIn('id', $remove)->get();
            foreach ($photos as $photo) {
                $this->deleteStoredFile($photo->path);
                $photo->delete();
            }
        }

        $order = (int) ($wedding->photos()->max('sort_order') ?? 0);
        foreach ($request->file('photos', []) as $file) {
            $wedding->photos()->create([
                'path' => $file->store('wedding/'.$wedding->id.'/galeri', 'public'),
                'sort_order' => ++$order,
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function deleteStoredFile(?string $path): void
    {
        if ($path && str_starts_with($path, 'wedding/')) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($path);
        }
    }

    private function uniqueSlug(string $base): string
    {
        $slug = $base;
        $i = 2;
        while (Wedding::where('slug', $slug)->exists()) {
            $slug = $base.'-'.$i++;
        }

        return $slug;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Wedding;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Wedding;
use App\Models\WeddingGuest;
use App\Services\Wedding\WhatsAppTemplate;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class GuestController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $weddings = $user->weddings()->with('template')->orderBy('event_date')->get();
        $wedding = $this->resolveWedding($request, $user);

        $query = WeddingGuest::query()
            ->when($wedding, fn ($q) => $q->where('wedding_id', $wedding->id))
            ->when(! $wedding, fn ($q) => $q->whereIn('wedding_id', $weddings->pluck('id')))
            ->with(['wedding', 'rsvp'])
            ->when($request->filled('q'), function ($q) use ($request) {
                $term = '%'.$request->string('q')->trim().'%';
                $q->where(fn ($inner) => $inner->where('name', 'like', $term)->orWhere('phone', 'like', $term));
            })
            ->when($request->filled('group'), fn ($q) => $q->where('group_name', $request->string('group')))
            ->when($request->filled('status'), function ($q) use ($request) {
                $status = $request->string('status')->toString();
                if ($status === 'sudah_rsvp') {
                    $q->whereHas('rsvp');
                } elseif ($status === 'belum_rsvp') {
                    $q->whereDoesntHave('rsvp');
                }
            })
            ->latest();

        return view('wedding.guests.index', [
            'weddings' => $weddings,
            'wedding' => $wedding,
            'guests' => $query->paginate(20)->withQueryString(),
            'groups' => WeddingGuest::when($wedding, fn ($q) => $q->where('wedding_id', $wedding->id))
                ->whereNotNull('group_name')->distinct()->orderBy('group_name')->pluck('group_name'),
            'package' => $user->activePackage(),
            'totalGuests' => WeddingGuest::when($wedding, fn ($q) => $q->where('wedding_id', $wedding->id))
                ->when(! $wedding, fn ($q) => $q->whereIn('wedding_id', $weddings->pluck('id')))->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $data = $request->validate([
            'wedding_id' => ['required', 'integer'],
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'phone' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:20'],
            'group_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'max_pax' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:20'],
        ]);

        $wedding = $user->weddings()->findOrFail($data['wedding_id']);
        $package = $user->activePackage();

        if ($wedding->guests()->count() >= $package->max_guests) {
            return back()->withErrors(['name' => "Paket {$package->name} mendukung maksimal {$package->max_guests} tamu."]);
        }

        $wedding->guests()->create([
            'name' => $data['name'],
            'phone' => $data['phone'] ?? null,
            'group_name' => $data['group_name'] ?? null,
            'max_pax' => $data['max_pax'] ?? 2,
        ]);

        return back()->with('status', 'Tamu berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    public function update(Request $request, WeddingGuest $guest): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('update', $guest->wedding);
        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'phone' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:20'],
            'group_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'max_pax' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:20'],
        ]);
        $guest->update($data);

        return back()->with('status', 'Data tamu diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(WeddingGuest $guest): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('update', $guest->wedding);
        $guest->delete();

        return back()->with('status', 'Tamu dihapus.');
    }

    public function import(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $request->validate([
            'wedding_id' => ['required', 'integer'],
            'file' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:csv,txt', 'max:5120'],
        ]);

        $wedding = $user->weddings()->findOrFail($request->integer('wedding_id'));
        $package = $user->activePackage();
        $current = $wedding->guests()->count();
        $remaining = max(0, $package->max_guests - $current);
        if ($remaining === 0) {
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => "Batas {$package->max_guests} tamu untuk paket {$package->name} sudah tercapai."]);
        }

        $handle = fopen($request->file('file')->getRealPath(), 'r');
        if (! $handle) {
            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'File tidak dapat dibaca.']);
        }

        $firstLine = fgets($handle);
        rewind($handle);
        $delimiter = ',';
        if ($firstLine !== false) {
            foreach ([';' => ';', "\t" => "\t"] as $candidate) {
                if (substr_count($firstLine, $candidate) > substr_count($firstLine, $delimiter)) {
                    $delimiter = $candidate;
                }
            }
        }

        $header = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter) ?: [];
        $map = $this->mapHeaders($header);
        if (! isset($map['name'])) {
            fclose($handle);

            return back()->withErrors(['file' => 'Header CSV harus memiliki kolom nama. Contoh: nama,telepon,grup,kuota']);
        }

        $rows = [];
        $skipped = 0;
        while (($line = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $delimiter)) !== false) {
            if (count($rows) >= min($remaining, config('wedding.limits.import_rows', 2000))) {
                break;
            }
            $name = trim((string) ($line[$map['name']] ?? ''));
            if ($name === '') {
                $skipped++;

                continue;
            }
            $rows[] = [
                'name' => mb_substr($name, 0, 100),
                'phone' => $this->cell($line, $map, 'phone'),
                'group_name' => $this->cell($line, $map, 'group'),
                'max_pax' => max(1, min(20, (int) ($this->cell($line, $map, 'pax') ?: 2))),
            ];
        }
        fclose($handle);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($wedding, $rows) {
            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                $wedding->guests()->create($row);
            }
        });

        return back()->with('status', count($rows).' tamu berhasil diimpor'.($skipped ? ", {$skipped} baris dilewati" : '').'.');
    }

    public function export(Request $request): StreamedResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $wedding = $this->resolveWedding($request, $user);
        $query = WeddingGuest::with(['wedding', 'rsvp'])
            ->when($wedding, fn ($q) => $q->where('wedding_id', $wedding->id))
            ->when(! $wedding, fn ($q) => $q->whereIn('wedding_id', $user->weddings()->pluck('id')))
            ->orderBy('name');

        $filename = 'tamu-'.($wedding?->slug ?? 'semua').'-'.now()->format('Ymd-His').'.csv';

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($query) {
            $out = fopen('php://output', 'w');
            fwrite($out, "\xEF\xBB\xBF");
            fputcsv($out, ['nama', 'telepon', 'grup', 'kuota', 'status_rsvp', 'jumlah_hadir', 'link_undangan']);
            foreach ($query->cursor() as $guest) {
                fputcsv($out, [
                    $guest->name,
                    $guest->phone,
                    $guest->group_name,
                    $guest->max_pax,
                    $guest->rsvp?->attendanceLabel() ?? 'Belum konfirmasi',
                    $guest->rsvp?->guests_count ?? 0,
                    $guest->link(),
                ]);
            }
            fclose($out);
        }, $filename, ['Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8']);
    }

    public function link(WeddingGuest $guest, WhatsAppTemplate $wa): JsonResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $guest->wedding);
        $link = $guest->link();
        $message = $wa->render("Assalamu'alaikum {{nama_tamu}},\n\nKami mengundang Anda untuk hadir di pernikahan {{nama_pria}} & {{nama_wanita}}.\n\n{{link_undangan}}", $guest->wedding, $guest);

        return response()->json([
            'link' => $link,
            'wa' => $guest->phone ? $wa->waUrl($guest->phone, $message) : null,
        ]);
    }

    private function resolveWedding(Request $request, $user): ?Wedding
    {
        if (! $request->filled('wedding')) {
            return null;
        }

        return $user->weddings()->findOrFail($request->integer('wedding'));
    }

    private function mapHeaders(array $header): array
    {
        $aliases = [
            'name' => ['nama', 'name', 'tamu', 'nama_tamu'],
            'phone' => ['telepon', 'phone', 'whatsapp', 'no_hp', 'nomor', 'hp'],
            'group' => ['grup', 'group', 'kategori', 'kelompok'],
            'pax' => ['kuota', 'pax', 'jumlah', 'jumlah_tamu', 'max_pax'],
        ];
        $map = [];
        foreach ($header as $i => $value) {
            $key = strtolower(trim((string) $value));
            $key = str_replace([' ', '-'], '_', $key);
            foreach ($aliases as $target => $names) {
                if (in_array($key, $names, true)) {
                    $map[$target] = $i;
                }
            }
        }

        return $map;
    }

    private function cell(array $line, array $map, string $key): ?string
    {
        if (! isset($map[$key])) {
            return null;
        }
        $value = trim((string) ($line[$map[$key]] ?? ''));

        return $value !== '' ? $value : null;
    }
}

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {

        if (! $package->allow_whatsapp) {

        $data = $request->validate([
            'wedding_id' => ['required', 'integer'],

            'message_template' => ['required', 'string', 'max:4000'],
        ]);

        $wedding = $user->weddings()->findOrFail($data['wedding_id']);

            'message_template' => $data['message_template'],
            'status' => 'draft',
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('wedding.broadcast.show', $campaign)
            ->with('status', 'Kampanye broadcast dibuat. Tinjau pesan sebelum membagikan link WhatsApp.');
    }

    public function show(Request $request, BroadcastCampaign $campaign, WhatsAppTemplate $wa)
    {
        $wedding = $campaign->wedding()->with(['events', 'template'])->firstOrFail();
        abort_unless($wedding->user_id === $request->user()->id, 404);

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Wedding;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Wedding;
use App\Models\WeddingGuest;
use App\Models\WeddingRsvp;
use App\Models\WeddingSetting;
use App\Models\WeddingWish;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class PublicInvitationController extends Controller
{
    public function show(Request $request, string $slug)
    {
        $wedding = Wedding::with([
            'template', 'events', 'stories', 'photos', 'gifts',
            'wishes' => fn ($q) => $q->where('status', 'approved')->latest()->take(60),
        ])->where('slug', $slug)->firstOrFail();

        $isOwner = $request->user() && $request->user()->id === $wedding->user_id;

        if (! $wedding->isPublished() && ! $isOwner) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $guest = $this->guestFromToken($request, $wedding);
        $rsvp = $guest?->rsvp;

        if ($guest && ! $guest->opened_at && $wedding->isPublished()) {
            $guest->forceFill(['opened_at' => now()])->save();
        }

        if ($wedding->isPublished()) {
            $sessionKey = 'wedding_viewed_'.$wedding->id;
            if (! $request->session()->has($sessionKey)) {
                $wedding->increment('views_count');
                $request->session()->put($sessionKey, true);
            }
        }

        $template = $wedding->template?->slug ?? 'melati';
        if (! view()->exists('wedding.templates.'.$template.'.index')) {
            $template = 'melati';
        }

        return response()
            ->view('wedding.templates.'.$template.'.index', [
                'wedding' => $wedding,
                'recipientName' => $guest?->name ?? 'Tamu Undangan',
                'guest' => $guest,
                'myRsvp' => $rsvp,
                'isPreview' => ! $wedding->isPublished(),
                'previewMode' => false,
                'embed' => false,
            ])
            ->header('X-Robots-Tag', $guest ? 'noindex, nofollow' : 'index, follow');
    }

    public function rsvp(Request $request, string $slug): RedirectResponse|JsonResponse
    {
        $wedding = Wedding::where('slug', $slug)->where('status', Wedding::STATUS_PUBLISHED)->firstOrFail();
        $guest = $this->guestFromToken($request, $wedding);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => [$guest ? 'nullable' : 'required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'attendance' => ['required', Rule::in(array_keys(WeddingRsvp::ATTENDANCE_LABELS))],
            'guests_count' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:20'],
            'message' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
        ], [
            'attendance.required' => 'Silakan pilih konfirmasi kehadiran.',
            'attendance.in' => 'Pilihan konfirmasi tidak valid.',
        ]);

        $name = $guest?->name ?: trim($data['name']);
        if ($name === '') {
            return back()->withErrors(['name' => 'Nama wajib diisi.'])->withInput();
        }

        $attributes = [
            'name' => $name,
            'attendance' => $data['attendance'],
            'guests_count' => $data['attendance'] === WeddingRsvp::HADIR ? $data['guests_count'] : 1,
            'message' => $data['message'] ?? null,
        ];

        if ($guest) {
            $wedding->rsvps()->updateOrCreate(['wedding_guest_id' => $guest->id], $attributes);
        } else {
            $wedding->rsvps()->create($attributes);
        }

        if ($request->expectsJson()) {
            return response()->json(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Terima kasih, konfirmasi kehadiran Anda telah kami terima.']);
        }

        return redirect()->to($wedding->invitationUrl($guest).'#konfirmasi')
            ->with('rsvp_success', 'Terima kasih, konfirmasi kehadiran Anda telah kami terima.');
    }

    public function wish(Request $request, string $slug): RedirectResponse|JsonResponse
    {
        $wedding = Wedding::where('slug', $slug)->where('status', Wedding::STATUS_PUBLISHED)->firstOrFail();
        $guest = $this->guestFromToken($request, $wedding);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => [$guest ? 'nullable' : 'required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'message' => ['required', 'string', 'max:600'],
        ]);

        $name = $guest?->name ?: trim((string) ($data['name'] ?? ''));
        if ($name === '') {
            return back()->withErrors(['name' => 'Nama wajib diisi.'])->withInput();
        }

        $status = WeddingSetting::get('wish_moderation', 'post') === 'pre' ? 'hidden' : 'approved';

        $wedding->wishes()->create([
            'wedding_guest_id' => $guest?->id,
            'name' => $name,
            'message' => $data['message'],
            'status' => $status,
        ]);

        if ($request->expectsJson()) {
            return response()->json([
                'ok' => true,
                'message' => $status === 'approved'
                    ? 'Ucapan dan doa Anda telah dikirim.'
                    : 'Ucapan Anda dikirim dan menunggu moderasi.',
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->to($wedding->invitationUrl($guest).'#ucapan')
            ->with('wish_success', $status === 'approved'
                ? 'Terima kasih, ucapan dan doa Anda telah kami terima.'
                : 'Terima kasih, ucapan Anda menunggu moderasi.');
    }

    private function guestFromToken(Request $request, Wedding $wedding): ?WeddingGuest
    {
        $token = $request->query('token');
        if (! is_string($token) || $token === '' || strlen($token) > 64) {
            return null;
        }

        return $wedding->guests()->where('token', $token)->first();
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Wedding\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\Subscription;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class PaymentController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $payments = Payment::with(['user', 'package', 'subscription'])
            ->when($request->filled('status'), fn ($q) => $q->where('status', $request->string('status')))
            ->latest()->paginate(20)->withQueryString();

        return view('wedding.admin.payments', compact('payments'));
    }

    public function confirm(Payment $payment)
    {
        if ($payment->status === 'dikonfirmasi') {
            return back()->with('status', 'Pembayaran ini sudah dikonfirmasi.');
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($payment) {
            $payment->update(['status' => 'dikonfirmasi', 'paid_at' => now()]);

            Subscription::where('user_id', $payment->user_id)
                ->where('status', 'aktif')
                ->update(['status' => 'selesai', 'ends_at' => now()]);

            $subscription = Subscription::create([
                'user_id' => $payment->user_id,
                'package_id' => $payment->package_id,
                'status' => 'aktif',
                'starts_at' => now(),
                'ends_at' => now()->addDays(30),
            ]);
            $payment->update(['subscription_id' => $subscription->id]);
        });

        return back()->with('status', 'Pembayaran dikonfirmasi dan langganan diaktifkan.');
    }

    public function reject(Request $request, Payment $payment)
    {
        $payment->update([
            'status' => 'ditolak',
            'notes' => trim(($payment->notes ? $payment->notes."\n" : '').'Ditolak admin: '.$request->string('reason')),
        ]);

        return back()->with('status', 'Pembayaran ditolak.');
    }
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build the Wedding module for **Markas Punokawan** as an isolated Laravel 12 module under `/wedding`, with 8 genuinely distinct invitation templates, customer/admin dashboards, editor, guest management, RSVP, wishes, WhatsApp click-to-chat, packages, and tests.
- The user explicitly requested implementation, not just analysis: audit the existing project, then implement stage by stage, test, fix errors, and report results.

## Requirements
- All Wedding URLs must use prefix `/wedding`; no takeover of `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/dashboard`, or other main platform routes.
- Use Laravel 12, PHP 8.2+, MySQL, Blade, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js/JS, Lucide Icons, Eloquent, Queue, Storage.
- Bahasa Indonesia for all UI and invitation content.
- 8 templates must have truly different concepts, layouts, typography, ornaments, CSS, animations, and JS: Melati, Senja, Lestari, Maharaja, Arum, Puspita, Asmara, Nirmala.
- Preview must use the exact same view and stylesheet as the public invitation.
- Catalog must show portrait thumbnails with real cover content, plus "Lihat Desain" and "Gunakan Template".
- Editor needs two panels, live preview, draft save, publish, section toggles.
- Personal guest links must validate token + wedding ownership; `to` URL param must not be trusted.
- WhatsApp must use official `wa.me` Click to Chat only; do not claim sent/read without confirmation.
- Security: auth, authorization, role middleware, CSRF, validation, XSS prevention, upload validation, rate limiting, customer data isolation.
- Responsive mobile-first public invitations; no horizontal overflow; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Separate platform layout/assets from Wedding module assets.
- Tests must cover auth, `/wedding` prefix, access control, invitation creation, template selection/change, preview/public consistency, token validation, import/export, RSVP, wishes, WhatsApp, and data isolation.
- Do not use placeholders for required features; do not stop at recommendations.

## Decisions
- Existing project was a partial prior attempt with root-level wedding routes and broken/mojibake template views; new module built under `resources/views/wedding` and `public/wedding/assets`, leaving old unused views mostly untouched.
- Root `/` now serves a separate Markas Punokawan platform landing; Wedding starts at `/wedding`.
- Existing models/migrations were preserved and extended with a new migration rather than rebuilding the database.
- Real demo wedding photos were downloaded from Unsplash into `public/wedding/assets/images/demo/` for premium visual quality.
- Catalog thumbnails use live `<iframe>` previews of the actual template route.
- Public invitation route `/wedding/{slug}` is placed last with a strict slug regex and reserved-slug validation.
- Customer/Admin dashboards use Tailwind + Vite; public marketing/site and each invitation template use separate standalone CSS files.
- Editor auto-save planned via AJAX `fetch` returning JSON, then refresh preview iframe; explicit save still supported.
- Package restrictions implemented in backend: max invitations, guests, photos, music, WhatsApp, export.
- Admin payment confirmation manually creates a 30-day subscription; no payment gateway.
- Demo customer account seeded only when `APP_ENV=local`: `demo@markaspunokawan.test` / `demo12345`.
- Admin seed account: `admin@markaspunokawan.test` / `ganti-kata-sandi-ini`.

## Work State

### Completed
- Audited existing Laravel 12 project, routes, models, migrations, controllers, views, tests, and assets.
- Created `config/wedding.php` with branding, reserved slugs, sections, language styles, quotes, 8 template metadata, demo data, limits.
- Created migration `2026_11_14_000001_extend_wedding_module.php`; ran successfully.
- Expanded `User`, `Wedding`, `Template`, `Package`, `WeddingGuest`, `WeddingEvent`, `WeddingRsvp`, `WeddingWish`, `BroadcastCampaign`, `BroadcastMessage`, `Payment`; added `WeddingSetting`, `WeddingActivityLog`.
- Added services: `DemoInvitation`, `TemplateRegistry`, `WhatsAppTemplate`.
- Created full route file `routes/wedding.php`; route list verified with 62 routes all under `/wedding`.
- Rewrote root `routes/web.php` to platform landing + Wedding include.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build the Wedding module for **Markas Punokawan** as an isolated Laravel 12 module under `/wedding`, with 8 genuinely distinct invitation templates, customer/admin dashboards, editor, guest management, RSVP, wishes, WhatsApp click-to-chat, packages, and tests.
- The user explicitly requested implementation, not just analysis: audit the existing project, then implement stage by stage, test, fix errors, and report results.

## Requirements
- All Wedding URLs must use prefix `/wedding`; no takeover of `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/dashboard`, or other main platform routes.
- Use Laravel 12, PHP 8.2+, MySQL, Blade, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js/JS, Lucide Icons, Eloquent, Queue, Storage.
- Bahasa Indonesia for all UI and invitation content.
- 8 templates must have truly different concepts, layouts, typography, ornaments, CSS, animations, and JS: Melati, Senja, Lestari, Maharaja, Arum, Puspita, Asmara, Nirmala.
- Preview must use the exact same view and stylesheet as the public invitation.
- Catalog must show portrait thumbnails with real cover content, plus "Lihat Desain" and "Gunakan Template".
- Editor needs two panels, live preview, draft save, publish, section toggles.
- Personal guest links must validate token + wedding ownership; `to` URL param must not be trusted.
- WhatsApp must use official `wa.me` Click to Chat only; do not claim sent/read without confirmation.
- Security: auth, authorization, role middleware, CSRF, validation, XSS prevention, upload validation, rate limiting, customer data isolation.
- Responsive mobile-first public invitations; no horizontal overflow; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Separate platform layout/assets from Wedding module assets.
- Tests must cover auth, `/wedding` prefix, access control, invitation creation, template selection/change, preview/public consistency, token validation, import/export, RSVP, wishes, WhatsApp, and data isolation.
- Do not use placeholders for required features; do not stop at recommendations.

## Decisions
- Existing project was a partial prior attempt with root-level wedding routes and broken/mojibake template views; new module built under `resources/views/wedding` and `public/wedding/assets`, leaving old unused views mostly untouched.
- Root `/` now serves a separate Markas Punokawan platform landing; Wedding starts at `/wedding`.
- Existing models/migrations were preserved and extended with a new migration rather than rebuilding the database.
- Real demo wedding photos were downloaded from Unsplash into `public/wedding/assets/images/demo/` for premium visual quality.
- Catalog thumbnails use live `<iframe>` previews of the actual template route.
- Public invitation route `/wedding/{slug}` is placed last with a strict slug regex and reserved-slug validation.
- Customer/Admin dashboards use Tailwind + Vite; public marketing/site and each invitation template use separate standalone CSS files.
- Editor auto-save planned via AJAX `fetch` returning JSON, then refresh preview iframe; explicit save still supported.
- Package restrictions implemented in backend: max invitations, guests, photos, music, WhatsApp, export.
- Admin payment confirmation manually creates a 30-day subscription; no payment gateway.
- Demo customer account seeded only when `APP_ENV=local`: `demo@markaspunokawan.test` / `demo12345`.
- Admin seed account: `admin@markaspunokawan.test` / `ganti-kata-sandi-ini`.
- Template pages will be standalone full HTML documents (not extending site layout), each with own CSS/JS and body class `.tpl-{slug}`; shared RSVP/wish partials use generic `.tw-*` classes styled per template.

## Work State

### Completed
- Audited existing Laravel 12 project, routes, models, migrations, controllers, views, tests, and assets.
- Created `config/wedding.php` with branding, reserved slugs, sections, language styles, quotes, 8 template metadata, demo data, limits.
- Created migration `2026_11_14_000001_extend_wedding_module.php`; ran successfully.
- Expanded `User`, `Wedding`, `Template`, `Package`, `WeddingGuest`, `WeddingEvent`, `WeddingRsvp`, `WeddingWish`, `BroadcastCampaign`, `BroadcastMessage`, `Payment`; added `WeddingSetting`, `WeddingActivityLog`.
- Added services: `DemoInvitation`, `TemplateRegistry`, `WhatsAppTemplate`.
- Created full route file `routes/wedding.php`; route list verified with 62 routes all under `/wedding`.
- Rewrote root `routes/web.php` to platform landing + Wedding include.
- Updated `bootstrap/app.php` guest redirect to `wedding.login`.
- Implemented controllers: Wedding Auth, Landing, Catalog, PackagePage, Dashboard, Invitation, Guest, RSVP, Wish, Broadcast, Account, Payment, PublicInvitation.
- Implemented admin controllers: Dashboard, Customer, Template, Wedding, Package, Payment, Setting.
- Rewrote `DatabaseSeeder` with 3 packages, 8 templates, admin, local demo customer + published `rangga-ayu` wedding with events/stories/photos/gifts/guests/RSVPs/wishes.
- Ran `php artisan migrate --force` and `php artisan db:seed --force` successfully.
- Downloaded 11 demo images to `public/wedding/assets/images/demo/`.
- Created platform landing `resources/views/platform/home.blade.php`.
- Created `wedding/layouts/site.blade.php`, `site.css`, `site.js`.
- Created public landing, catalog, template preview shell, packages pages.
- Created `wedding/public/partials/template-card.blade.php` using real iframe previews.
- Created auth layout, login, and register views.
- Created customer dashboard layout `wedding/layouts/dashboard.blade.php`.
- Created customer dashboard pages: `dashboard/index`, `invitations/{index,create,show,edit}`, `guests/index`, `rsvp/index`, `wishes/index`, `broadcast/{index,show}`, `account/edit`, `subscription/index`.
- Modified `InvitationController::edit` to pass `editorData` (form/events/stories/gifts/savedAt) for the Alpine editor.
- Built functional two-panel editor with autosave via fetch, live preview reload, publish button, template change form, and file uploads.
- Created admin layout `wedding/layouts/admin.blade.php` and all admin views: `admin/{dashboard,customers,customer-show,templates,weddings,packages,payments,settings}`.
- Created shared template partials `wedding/templates/partials/rsvp.blade.php` and `wishes.blade.php` using generic `.tw-*` classes.

### Active
- Building all 8 template folders under `resources/views/wedding/templates/{slug}/` and matching `public/wedding/assets/templates/{slug}.css` (+ JS).
- Planned concepts: Melati classic floral; Senja modern editorial; Lestari botanical; Maharaja royal black/gold; Arum rustic; Puspita Javanese; Asmara romantic; Nirmala dark cinematic.
- After templates: run `npm run build`, run/update tests, start server on non-8000 port, manual verification, documentation.

### Blocked
- Public invitation and template preview currently 404/render errors until `resources/views/wedding/templates/{slug}/index.blade.php` files exist.
- Catalog/landing iframes rely on the template preview route and will show errors until those views/CSS exist.
- Dashboard pages may fail if any referenced view/route mismatch remains; not yet browser-verified.

## Next Move
1. Implement all 8 template folders with per-template `index.blade.php`, `cover`/`sections`/`closing` partials, unique CSS at `public/wedding/assets/templates/{slug}.css`, optional JS at `public/wedding/assets/templates/{slug}.js`.
2. Ensure each template handles cover/open overlay, guest personalization via `$recipientName`/`$guest`, countdown, events, couple, quote, story, gallery, gifts, RSVP partial, wishes partial, closing, and preview mode disabling submissions.
3. Run `npm run build`.
4. Run `php artisan test`; migrate old tests from root URLs to `/wedding`; fix failures.
5. Start server on port 8001 (8000 occupied) and manually verify landing, catalog, preview, public invitation, login, dashboard, editor autosave/publish, guest import/export/link, RSVP, wishes, broadcast, admin pages.
6. Write documentation (`README-WEDDING.md` or similar) listing files created/changed and install steps.

## Relevant Files
- `routes/wedding.php`: Complete route definitions; reference for all URLs/names.
- `config/wedding.php`: Central module metadata, 8 template definitions, defaults, limits.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/InvitationController.php`: Editor/update/upload/publish logic; `edit` now passes `editorData`.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/PublicInvitationController.php`: Public render, token validation, RSVP/wish submission.
- `app/Services/Wedding/DemoInvitation.php`: Demo data shape used by previews and template rendering.
- `app/Models/Wedding.php`: Relations, section toggles, asset/url helpers, quote/opening/closing helpers.
- `resources/views/wedding/layouts/dashboard.blade.php`: Customer dashboard shell and expected `@section` names.
- `resources/views/wedding/layouts/admin.blade.php`: Admin shell and nav.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/edit.blade.php`: Two-panel Alpine editor; depends on `$editorData`.
- `resources/views/wedding/templates/partials/rsvp.blade.php`: Shared RSVP form; expects `$wedding`, `$guest`, `$myRsvp`, `$previewMode`.
- `resources/views/wedding/templates/partials/wishes.blade.php`: Shared wish form/list; expects `$wedding`, `$guest`, `$previewMode`.
- `public/wedding/assets/css/site.css`: Marketing/preview shell styling and iframe framing.
- `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php`: Seeds packages/templates/admin/local demo wedding.
- `database/migrations/2026_11_12_000002_create_platform_tables.php`: Full table schema reference.
- `tests/Feature/*`: Existing tests still reference old root URLs and must be migrated.

## Important Context
- Working project root: `C:\Users\admin\Documents\Codex\2026-11-11\master-prompt-codex-platform-saas-undangan`.
- There is a nested duplicate project directory named `master-prompt-codex-platform-saas-undangan`; ignore it and work in the outer root.
- PHP 8.2.12 and MySQL `ujicoba` database are working; migrations and seeder already ran.
- Laravel 12, Tailwind 4, Alpine.js; `npm run build` has not yet been run after view changes.
- Port 8000 already has a listener from another process; use another port (e.g. 8001) for testing.
- The 8 template preview routes currently depend on missing `wedding.templates.{slug}.index` views.
- Public controller falls back to `melati` if selected template view is missing; catalog preview does not fallback.
- `wedding/{slug}` public route is intentionally last and constrained; `/wedding/login`, `/wedding/templates`, `/wedding/paket`, customer/admin routes are declared earlier.
- Old root-level wedding views in `resources/views/dashboard`, `resources/views/invitations`, etc. are obsolete; do not use them.
- Demo wedding slug: `/wedding/rangga-ayu`; demo guest records exist with generated tokens but tokens are not printed anywhere yet.
- `.env` uses `DB_DATABASE=ujicoba`, `APP_ENV=local`, MySQL root with empty password.
- `resources/css/app.css` and `resources/js/app.js` are used via Vite for dashboard/auth/admin; site/marketing and invitation templates use static public CSS.
- Template shared partials use `.tw-block`, `.tw-form`, `.tw-field`, `.tw-label`, `.tw-input`, `.tw-textarea`, `.tw-btn`, `.tw-choice`, `.tw-choices`, `.tw-note`, `.tw-alert`, `.tw-wish`, `.tw-wish-list`, `.tw-empty`; each template CSS must style these.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build the Wedding module for **Markas Punokawan** as an isolated Laravel 12 module under `/wedding`, with 8 genuinely distinct invitation templates, customer/admin dashboards, editor, guest management, RSVP, wishes, WhatsApp click-to-chat, packages, and tests.
- The user requested full implementation stage by stage, testing, fixes, and a final report — not analysis only.

## Requirements
- All Wedding URLs use `/wedding`; no takeover of `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/dashboard`, or other main platform routes.
- Laravel 12, PHP 8.2+, MySQL, Blade, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js/JS, Lucide Icons, Eloquent, Queue, Storage.
- All UI and invitation content in Bahasa Indonesia.
- 8 templates must have truly different concepts, layouts, typography, ornaments, CSS, animations, and JS: Melati, Senja, Lestari, Maharaja, Arum, Puspita, Asmara, Nirmala.
- Preview must use the exact same view and stylesheet as the public invitation.
- Catalog must show portrait thumbnails with real cover content, plus "Lihat Desain" and "Gunakan Template".
- Editor needs two panels, live preview, draft save, publish, section toggles.
- Personal guest links must validate token + wedding ownership; `to` URL param must not be trusted.
- WhatsApp must use official `wa.me` Click to Chat only; do not claim sent/read without confirmation.
- Security: auth, authorization, role middleware, CSRF, validation, XSS prevention, upload validation, rate limiting, customer data isolation.
- Responsive mobile-first public invitations; no horizontal overflow; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Separate platform layout/assets from Wedding module assets.
- Tests must cover auth, `/wedding` prefix, access control, invitation creation, template selection/change, preview/public consistency, token validation, import/export, RSVP, wishes, WhatsApp, and data isolation.
- Do not use placeholders for required features; do not stop at recommendations.

## Decisions
- Existing project was a partial prior attempt with root-level wedding routes and broken/mojibake template views; new module lives under `resources/views/wedding` and `public/wedding/assets`, leaving old unused views mostly untouched.
- Root `/` serves a separate Markas Punokawan platform landing; Wedding starts at `/wedding`.
- Existing models/migrations preserved and extended with a new migration rather than rebuilding the database.
- Real demo wedding photos downloaded from Unsplash into `public/wedding/assets/images/demo/`.
- Catalog thumbnails use live `<iframe>` previews of the actual template route.

## Objective
- Build the Wedding module for **Markas Punokawan** as an isolated Laravel 12 module under `/wedding`, with 8 genuinely distinct invitation templates, customer/admin dashboards, editor, guest management, RSVP, wishes, WhatsApp click-to-chat, packages, and tests.
- User expects full implementation stage by stage, testing, fixes, and a final report — not analysis only.

## Requirements
- All Wedding URLs use `/wedding`; no takeover of `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/dashboard`, or other main platform routes.
- Laravel 12, PHP 8.2+, MySQL, Blade, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js/JS, Lucide Icons, Eloquent, Queue, Storage.
- All UI and invitation content in Bahasa Indonesia.
- 8 templates must have truly different concepts, layouts, typography, ornaments, CSS, animations, and JS: Melati, Senja, Lestari, Maharaja, Arum, Puspita, Asmara, Nirmala.
- Preview must use the exact same view and stylesheet as the public invitation.
- Catalog must show portrait thumbnails with real cover content, plus "Lihat Desain" and "Gunakan Template".
- Editor needs two panels, live preview, draft save, publish, section toggles.
- Personal guest links must validate token + wedding ownership; `to` URL param must not be trusted.
- WhatsApp must use official `wa.me` Click to Chat only; do not claim sent/read without confirmation.
- Security: auth, authorization, role middleware, CSRF, validation, XSS prevention, upload validation, rate limiting, customer data isolation.
- Responsive mobile-first public invitations; no horizontal overflow; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Separate platform layout/assets from Wedding module assets.
- Tests must cover auth, `/wedding` prefix, access control, invitation creation, template selection/change, preview/public consistency, token validation, import/export, RSVP, wishes, WhatsApp, and data isolation.
- Do not use placeholders for required features; do not stop at recommendations.

## Decisions
- Existing partial project preserved; new module lives under `resources/views/wedding` and `public/wedding/assets`, leaving obsolete root-level wedding views untouched.
- Root `/` serves a separate Markas Punokawan platform landing; Wedding starts at `/wedding`.
- Existing models/migrations preserved and extended with a new migration rather than rebuilding the database.
- Real demo wedding photos downloaded from Unsplash into `public/wedding/assets/images/demo/`.
- Catalog thumbnails use live `<iframe>` previews of the actual template route.
- Public invitation route `/wedding/{slug}` is last with strict slug regex and reserved-slug validation.

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Wedding;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Concerns\CreatesWeddings;
use Tests\TestCase;

class InvitationFlowTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase, CreatesWeddings;

    private function payload(array $over = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'groom_name' => 'Andi', 'bride_name' => 'Siti', 'slug' => 'andi-siti',
            'template_id' => $this->makeTemplate()->id,
        ], $over);
    }

    public function test_customer_membuat_undangan_draf_dengan_template(): void
    {
        $user = $this->makeCustomer();
        $this->actingAs($user)->post('/dashboard/invitations', $this->payload())->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $wedding = Wedding::firstWhere('slug', 'andi-siti');
        $this->assertSame($user->id, $wedding->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('draft', $wedding->status);
        $this->assertFalse($wedding->sectionEnabled('kisah'));
        $this->assertTrue($wedding->sectionEnabled('rsvp'));
    }

    public function test_slug_yang_dicadangkan_ditolak(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->makeCustomer())
            ->post('/dashboard/invitations', $this->payload(['slug' => 'admin']))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('slug');
    }

    public function test_slug_tidak_valid_ditolak(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->makeCustomer())
            ->post('/dashboard/invitations', $this->payload(['slug' => 'Andi Siti!']))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('slug');
    }

    public function test_paket_gratis_dibatasi_satu_undangan(): void
    {
        $user = $this->makeCustomer();
        $this->actingAs($user)->post('/dashboard/invitations', $this->payload());
        $this->actingAs($user)->post('/dashboard/invitations', $this->payload(['slug' => 'kedua']))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('limit');

        $this->assertSame(1, $user->weddings()->count());
    }

    public function test_publikasi_dan_kembali_ke_draf(): void
    {
        $user = $this->makeCustomer();
        $wedding = $this->makeWedding($user, 'andi-siti', 'draft');

        $this->actingAs($user)->post("/dashboard/invitations/{$wedding->id}/publish");
        $this->assertTrue($wedding->fresh()->isPublished());

        $this->actingAs($user)->post("/dashboard/invitations/{$wedding->id}/publish");
        $this->assertFalse($wedding->fresh()->isPublished());
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\WeddingGuest;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Concerns\CreatesWeddings;
use Tests\TestCase;

class PublicInvitationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase, CreatesWeddings;

    public function test_link_umum_menampilkan_tamu_undangan(): void
    {
        $this->makeWedding($this->makeCustomer());
        $this->get('/andi-siti')->assertOk()->assertSee('Tamu Undangan');
    }

    public function test_draf_tidak_bisa_dilihat_publik_tetapi_bisa_oleh_pemilik(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeCustomer();
        $this->makeWedding($owner, 'andi-siti', 'draft');

        $this->get('/andi-siti')->assertNotFound();
        $this->actingAs($owner)->get('/andi-siti')->assertOk();
    }

    public function test_token_valid_menampilkan_nama_dari_database(): void
    {
        $wedding = $this->makeWedding($this->makeCustomer());
        $guest = $wedding->guests()->create(['name' => 'Syahron', 'phone' => '081234567890']);

        $this->get('/andi-siti?to=Palsu&token='.$guest->token)
            ->assertOk()->assertSee('Syahron')->assertDontSee('Palsu');
        $this->assertNotNull($guest->fresh()->opened_at);
    }

    public function test_nama_di_url_tanpa_token_valid_tidak_dipercaya(): void
    {
        $this->makeWedding($this->makeCustomer());

        $this->get('/andi-siti?to=Hacker')->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Hacker')->assertSee('Tamu Undangan');
        $this->get('/andi-siti?to=Hacker&token=tokensalah')->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Hacker');
    }

    public function test_token_milik_undangan_lain_tidak_berlaku(): void
    {
        $wedding = $this->makeWedding($this->makeCustomer(), 'andi-siti');
        $lain = $this->makeWedding($this->makeCustomer(), 'budi-ani');
        $tamuLain = $lain->guests()->create(['name' => 'Tamu Rahasia']);

        $this->get('/andi-siti?token='.$tamuLain->token)->assertDontSee('Tamu Rahasia')->assertSee('Tamu Undangan');
    }

    public function test_token_unik_dan_nomor_dinormalisasi(): void
    {
        $wedding = $this->makeWedding($this->makeCustomer());
        $a = $wedding->guests()->create(['name' => 'A', 'phone' => '0812-3456-7890']);
        $b = $wedding->guests()->create(['name' => 'B']);

        $this->assertNotSame($a->token, $b->token);
        $this->assertSame(40, strlen($a->token));
        $this->assertSame('+6281234567890', $a->phone);
    }
}
