# Skill: OpenCode

# OpenCode

Use this guide as the starting point for work involving OpenCode itself. It
covers the core concepts needed to configure and customize OpenCode, extend it
with plugins, and build integrations with the OpenCode SDK, clients, and API.

Full documentation is available at <https://opencode.ai/docs/>. This overview is
only an index of core concepts. Before answering a question about a topic below,
fetch the URL named in that section and use the full page as the source of
truth. Follow links from that page when the question needs more detail. Fetch
<https://opencode.ai/docs/> first when you need to discover the relevant
documentation page.

A machine-readable documentation index is available at
<https://opencode.ai/docs/llms.txt>.

## Version policy

Always answer for OpenCode V2 unless the user explicitly asks about V1,
legacy OpenCode, or migrating from V1.

Use only <https://opencode.ai/docs/> documentation as the source of truth for V2.
Do not use <https://opencode.ai/docs/>, which documents V1, and do not use
general web search to resolve a V2 documentation question when the V2 docs or
linked pages cover it. The schema served from
<https://opencode.ai/config.json> accepts both V2 fields and deprecated V1
fields. Never recommend a field it marks deprecated. If V2 documentation is
missing or contradictory, state the uncertainty or ask for clarification instead of falling back to V1.

V1 documentation and syntax may be consulted only when the user explicitly
asks about V1 or when needed as migration input. Outputs and recommendations
must still use V2 unless the user specifically requests a V1 result.

## [CLI](https://opencode.ai/docs/cli)

For questions about the terminal interface, command-line invocation, `run`,
`mini`, terminal providers, or other CLI behavior, fetch the
[CLI guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/cli) and the relevant page linked from
that section.

CLI and TUI preferences are separate from OpenCode's server and project
configuration. They live in the global `~/.config/opencode/cli.json`, or
`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/cli.json` when `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is set. There is no
project-local CLI configuration. Set `OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT` to merge
inline JSON over the global settings. Most preferences can also be changed from
the TUI by pressing `Ctrl+P` and selecting **Open settings**.

### [Settings](https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/config)

Fetch the full [CLI settings reference](https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/config)
before editing `cli.json`. It documents every terminal-only setting, accepted
values, and examples, including themes, input, sessions, tabs, diffs, alerts,
Mini, keybindings, terminal plugins, and debugging. Do not put these settings
in `opencode.json(c)`.

### [Keybinds](https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/keybinds)

Configure keybindings under `keybinds` in `cli.json`. The leader key is the
`keybinds.leader` entry; leader timing is configured separately under
`leader.timeout`. Bindings can use a string, an array of strings, or an object
when event behavior such as `preventDefault` is required. Disable a binding
with `"none"` or `false`.

Never guess a command ID, default binding, or accepted key syntax. Fetch the
full [keybind reference](https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/keybinds), which lists
the current IDs and defaults, before answering or editing a binding.

## [OpenCode configuration](https://opencode.ai/docs/config)

OpenCode's server and project configuration uses JSON or JSONC. Include the
published schema so the user's editor can validate fields and provide
autocomplete:

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
}
```

Global configuration lives at `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json(c)` and applies
to every project for that user. Project configuration can live in any directory
as `opencode.json(c)` or `.opencode/opencode.json(c)`, including nested packages
in a monorepo.

During ordinary project discovery, OpenCode searches the current Location
directory and every ancestor through the filesystem root, including directories
above the detected project or repository root. It merges direct
`opencode.json(c)` files from the farthest ancestor to the current directory,
then does the same for `.opencode/opencode.json(c)` files. This means every
discovered `.opencode` config overrides every discovered direct config. Global
filesystem configuration has lower precedence than these discovered documents.

Common configuration fields include `model`, `default_agent`, `permissions`,
`agents`, `commands`, `plugins`, `providers`, `mcp`, `skills`, `instructions`,
`references`, `formatter`, and `lsp`.

This configuration is distinct from `cli.json`. Use the
[CLI settings reference](https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/config) for terminal
preferences, especially themes and keybindings.

Config changes apply without a restart. OpenCode watches config files and
reloads agents, commands, skills, MCP servers, and plugins after a save. The TUI
does the same for `cli.json`. To force a full reload, use `/reload`. Don't tell
the user to restart OpenCode after editing config.

Do not guess field names or shapes. Fetch the V2 configuration guide and its
linked topic guide as the source of truth, and preserve unrelated settings when
editing an existing file. Keep the published `$schema` URL in configuration
examples, but do not fetch it to determine the V2 configuration shape.

See the [full configuration guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/config) for
every field, examples, config locations, and links to dedicated feature guides.

## [MCP servers](https://opencode.ai/docs/mcp-servers)

Configure MCP servers under `mcp.servers`. Prefer the CLI because it preserves
unrelated configuration. Use `--global` when the user asks to set up a service
for themselves without limiting it to the current project; omit it when they
explicitly want project-local configuration.

```sh
opencode mcp add <name> --global --url <remote-url>
opencode mcp list
```

Remote servers use OAuth by default. If `mcp list` reports that a server needs
authentication, tell the user to run `/mcps`, select the server, and sign in.
Do not run `opencode mcp auth` through the shell tool: it starts an interactive
flow whose authorization link can be hidden in background process output.
Use the user-facing MCP interface instead.

Report the server as configured but awaiting sign-in until its connection
status confirms it is connected.

OAuth credentials are stored outside the OpenCode configuration. Do not ask for or
store an API key when the server supports OAuth. Use header-based credentials
only when OAuth is unavailable or the user explicitly requires them, and use an
environment substitution such as `{env:MCP_API_KEY}` instead of writing a
secret into configuration.

## [V1 to V2 migration](https://opencode.ai/docs/migrate-v1)

For any request to migrate OpenCode configuration, agents, commands, skills,
plugins, integrations, or other behavior from V1 to V2, read the full
[migration guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/migrate-v1) before acting. In
the repository, its source is `services/site/src/docs/content/migrate-v1.mdx`.

V1 config files and `.opencode/` definitions are intended to remain compatible.
The only intentional breaking changes are the server API and plugin API. Native
V2 config uses more ergonomic shapes, but conversion is optional. When the user
requests conversion, inspect the complete configuration, preserve behavior and
unrelated settings, and apply only the relevant migrations from the guide. For
plugin migrations, fetch and follow both the migration guide and the full
[plugins guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/plugins). If non-API V1
functionality fails in V2, use the `report` skill to file it as a compatibility
bug.

## [Plugins](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/plugins)

For questions about creating, configuring, loading, publishing, or migrating
plugins, fetch the full [plugins guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/plugins)
before answering. Refer to this guide when the user wants to build a plugin. It
covers hooks, transforms, tools, plugin context capabilities, and package
entrypoints. Plugins can also extend the TUI; for those, fetch the
[CLI plugin guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/plugins/cli).
For custom methods and events shared with other plugins or clients, fetch the
[RPC guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/plugins/rpc).

## [Service](https://opencode.ai/docs/troubleshooting#check-the-background-service)

OpenCode uses a client-server architecture. Interfaces such as the TUI connect
to a background OpenCode service, which owns sessions, configuration, plugins,
permissions, and tool execution.

OpenCode normally discovers or starts the shared background service
automatically. Restart it only if it is stuck or unhealthy, not to apply
configuration changes:

```sh
opencode service restart
```

Check its status after restarting:

```sh
opencode service status
```

## [API](https://opencode.ai/docs/api)

OpenCode exposes an HTTP API from its server. The API is described by an
OpenAPI document available from the running server at `/openapi.json`.

In Code Mode, use the built-in `opencode` tool namespace first, called inside
`execute` as `tools.opencode.*`. These tools skip the shell round-trip and
handle discovery and authentication; find its tools with Code Mode's `search`,
for example `search({ namespace: "opencode" })`. For anything they do not cover,
use the `opencode api` command. It uses the same discovery and authentication
flow as the TUI and may start the background service when no compatible healthy
service is available. It accepts either an HTTP method and path or an OpenAPI
operation ID.

Call an endpoint with an HTTP method and path:

```sh
opencode api get /api/info
```

Pass a request body with `--data` or `-d`, and additional headers with
`--header` or `-H`:

```sh
opencode api post /api/example --data '{"key":"value"}'
opencode api get /api/example --header 'X-Example:value'
```

Request bodies default to `Content-Type: application/json`. When OpenCode is
connected to an explicit server instead of its managed background service, use
the same configured server and authentication context rather than constructing
an unauthenticated request separately.

See the [full API reference](https://opencode.ai/docs/api) for available
endpoints, parameters, request bodies, and response schemas. The
raw [OpenAPI specification](https://opencode.ai/docs/openapi.json) is also
available for code generation and other tooling.

## [Client](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/client)

For questions about connecting an application to OpenCode over the network,
fetch the full [client guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/client) before
answering.

`@opencode/client` is the generated TypeScript client for the OpenCode HTTP
API. Its methods and types come from the same contract as the API reference.
The default entrypoint exposes Promise-based resource clients and async
iterables for streaming endpoints. The `@opencode/client/effect` entrypoint
exposes typed Effects, Streams, and decoded OpenCode schema values. Its
`Service` API can discover, start, stop, and authenticate with the local
background service from a Node application.

## [SDK](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/sdk)

For questions about embedding OpenCode directly in an application, fetch the
full [SDK guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/sdk) before answering. The SDK
hosts OpenCode in the application without opening an HTTP listener.

Use the [Effect SDK guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/sdk/effect) for
Effect applications. For Cloudflare Durable Objects, use the
[Cloudflare SDK guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/build/sdk/cloudflare).

## [Troubleshooting](https://opencode.ai/docs/troubleshooting)

OpenCode runs a client and a background server. Start by determining whether a
problem belongs to the client, the shared server, or one project.

- Check the service with `opencode service status` and verify the API with
  `opencode api get /api/info`.
- Compare with `opencode --standalone`, which runs the TUI with a private
  server, to isolate shared-service issues.
- Inspect `~/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log`. Filter `role=cli` for
  client startup and `role=server` for sessions, providers, plugins,
  permissions, and tools.
- Run one reproduction with `OPENCODE_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG` when normal logs are not
  sufficient.
- Do not delete or edit the database, service registration, or service config
  while diagnosing a problem. Back up persistent data before inspecting it
  with external tools.
- Redact API keys, authorization headers, prompts, file contents, and other
  sensitive data before sharing diagnostics.

See the [full troubleshooting guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/troubleshooting)
for service lifecycle commands, API inspection, log locations, explicit server
connections, issue-reporting details, and local development paths.

# PROMPT PERBAIKAN SISTEM MARKAS PUNOKAWAN — WEDDING

Bertindaklah sebagai Senior Laravel Developer dan Software Architect.

Lakukan audit terhadap implementasi Markas Punokawan – Wedding yang sudah selesai dibuat. Saya menemukan beberapa ketidaksesuaian sistem dan bug yang harus diperbaiki.

**PENTING:**
- Jangan membangun ulang aplikasi dari awal.
- Jangan menghapus fitur yang sudah berjalan dengan baik.
- Jangan merusak desain delapan template yang sudah dibuat.
- Periksa struktur database, migration, model, controller, middleware, route, Blade, JavaScript, dan seluruh alur yang berkaitan sebelum melakukan perubahan.
- Fokus pada perbaikan sistem yang sudah ada.

---

## 1. HAPUS SISTEM PAKET DAN PENGGUNA GRATIS

Saya memutuskan untuk tidak menggunakan sistem paket berlangganan.

Hapus seluruh konsep:
- Paket Gratis.
- Paket Basic.
- Paket Premium.
- Subscription.
- Pembatasan fitur berdasarkan paket.
- Status berlangganan.
- Upgrade paket.
- Pembayaran otomatis.
- Payment gateway.
- Harga paket.

Semua customer mendapatkan hak akses yang sama.

### Aturan penggunaan customer

Setiap customer yang sudah memiliki akun dapat:

1. Membuat undangan tanpa batasan paket.
2. Memilih seluruh template yang tersedia.
3. Mengedit seluruh bagian undangan.
4. Mengganti desain kapan saja selama belum dipublikasikan.
5. Mengunggah foto.
6. Mengatur informasi pernikahan.
7. Mengelola daftar tamu.
8. Mengatur RSVP dan ucapan.
9. Melihat preview undangan secara keseluruhan.
10. Menyimpan perubahan sebagai draft.

**Tidak ada pembayaran untuk sekadar membuat dan mengedit undangan.**

Namun, customer tidak mempunyai hak untuk memublikasikan undangan sendiri.

---

## 2. SISTEM PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI KE ADMIN

Buat sistem pengajuan publikasi undangan.

Alur yang diinginkan:

CUSTOMER MEMBUAT UNDANGAN
↓
CUSTOMER MEMILIH TEMPLATE
↓
CUSTOMER MENGEDIT UNDANGAN
↓
CUSTOMER MELAKUKAN PREVIEW
↓
CUSTOMER MEMASTIKAN DESAIN SUDAH FINAL
↓
CUSTOMER MENEKAN TOMBOL AJUKAN KE ADMIN
↓
ADMIN MENERIMA PENGAJUAN
↓
CUSTOMER MELAKUKAN PEMBAYARAN MELALUI CHAT PRIBADI ADMIN
↓
ADMIN MEMERIKSA PEMBAYARAN
↓
ADMIN MENGONFIRMASI PEMBAYARAN
↓
ADMIN MELAKUKAN PUBLIKASI
↓
UNDANGAN ONLINE DAN DAPAT DIAKSES PUBLIK
↓
CUSTOMER DAPAT MEMBAGIKAN LINK MELALUI WHATSAPP

### A. Sisi customer

Tambahkan tombol:

**AJUKAN PUBLIKASI**

Tombol hanya muncul ketika undangan sudah memiliki informasi minimum yang diperlukan dan belum dipublikasikan.

Ketika ditekan:

- Tampilkan konfirmasi bahwa desain undangan sudah final.
- Berikan informasi bahwa pengajuan akan dikirim kepada admin.
- Berikan informasi bahwa pembayaran dilakukan secara manual melalui chat pribadi admin.
- Setelah dikonfirmasi, ubah status undangan menjadi menunggu konfirmasi admin.

Setelah pengajuan dikirim, tampilkan status yang jelas pada dashboard customer.

Status yang diperlukan:

| Status | Keterangan |
|---|---|
| Draft | Undangan sedang dibuat atau diedit |
| Menunggu Konfirmasi | Pengajuan sudah dikirim kepada admin |
| Menunggu Pembayaran | Admin sudah memberikan instruksi pembayaran |
| Menunggu Verifikasi | Customer menginformasikan bahwa pembayaran sudah dilakukan |
| Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi | Admin sudah memverifikasi pembayaran |
| Dipublikasikan | Admin sudah memublikasikan undangan |
| Revisi | Admin meminta customer memperbaiki undangan |

Jangan membuat status pembayaran dikonfirmasi secara otomatis.

### B. Sisi admin

Pada dashboard Super Admin Wedding, buat menu baru:

**PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI**

Admin dapat melihat:

- Nama customer.
- Nama pasangan.
- Judul undangan.
- Template yang digunakan.
- Link atau slug undangan.
- Tanggal pengajuan.
- Status pengajuan.
- Preview undangan.
- Status pembayaran.

Sediakan tindakan:

1. Lihat Detail.
2. Preview Undangan.
3. Hubungi Customer melalui WhatsApp.
4. Konfirmasi Instruksi Pembayaran.
5. Tandai Pembayaran Sudah Diterima.
6. Minta Revisi.
7. Publikasikan Undangan.

### C. Pembayaran manual

Tidak perlu membuat sistem pembayaran otomatis.

Customer melakukan pembayaran melalui komunikasi pribadi dengan admin.

Sediakan tombol WhatsApp yang mengarahkan customer kepada nomor WhatsApp resmi admin yang dikonfigurasi melalui pengaturan aplikasi.

Gunakan pesan otomatis yang berisi:
- Nama customer.
- Nama pasangan.
- ID undangan.
- Informasi pengajuan publikasi.

Nomor WhatsApp admin jangan di-hardcode di banyak file. Gunakan konfigurasi terpusat yang dapat diubah oleh Super Admin.

Admin hanya boleh mengubah status pembayaran menjadi terkonfirmasi setelah benar-benar memeriksa pembayaran.

### D. Publikasi hanya oleh admin

Ini merupakan aturan yang sangat penting.

**Customer tidak boleh mempunyai kemampuan untuk memublikasikan undangan sendiri, baik melalui dashboard, manipulasi URL, request langsung, maupun API.**

Publikasi hanya dapat dilakukan oleh akun Super Admin yang memiliki otorisasi.

Sebelum memublikasikan, sistem harus memeriksa:

- Undangan sudah diajukan.
- Pembayaran sudah dikonfirmasi admin.
- Data undangan sudah memenuhi persyaratan.
- Slug tersedia dan valid.
- Tidak ada masalah pada data undangan.

Setelah semua persyaratan terpenuhi, admin dapat menekan tombol:

**PUBLIKASIKAN UNDANGAN**

Setelah berhasil:
- Status undangan berubah menjadi Dipublikasikan.
- `published_at` diisi.
- Halaman publik undangan dapat diakses.
- Link undangan dapat dibagikan.
- Customer mendapatkan notifikasi bahwa undangannya sudah online.

Jangan mengizinkan customer mengubah status publikasi melalui request biasa.

### E. Pengeditan setelah pengajuan

Jika customer ingin mengubah desain atau isi undangan setelah mengajukan publikasi:

- Customer harus membatalkan pengajuan atau meminta revisi.
- Admin dapat mengembalikan status pengajuan menjadi Revisi.
- Setelah customer melakukan perubahan, customer harus mengajukan kembali.
- Jika desain berubah setelah pembayaran dikonfirmasi tetapi sebelum publikasi, admin harus memeriksa ulang hasil akhirnya.

Untuk undangan yang sudah dipublikasikan, jangan mengizinkan perubahan penting secara diam-diam. Gunakan mekanisme pengeditan dan penyimpanan perubahan yang tetap menjaga halaman publik tetap stabil sampai perubahan disetujui atau diterapkan.

---

## 3. PERBAIKI BUG SLUG / LINK UNDANGAN

Saat customer mengisi link undangan, sistem tidak mengizinkan penggunaan karakter tanda hubung `-`.

Ini merupakan bug yang harus diperbaiki.

Contoh slug yang harus diterima:

- andi-siti
- andi-putri
- syahron-maulana
- ahmad-fitria-2026
- undangan-pernikahan-andi-siti

Contoh URL:

`/wedding/andi-siti`

`/wedding/syahron-maulana`

### Aturan validasi slug

Gunakan format slug yang mendukung:

- Huruf kecil `a-z`.
- Angka `0-9`.
- Tanda hubung `-`.

Contoh pola regex:

`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`

Ketentuan:
- Slug tidak boleh diawali tanda hubung.
- Slug tidak boleh diakhiri tanda hubung.
- Tidak boleh terdapat tanda hubung berulang seperti `andi--siti`.
- Tidak boleh menggunakan spasi.
- Tidak boleh menggunakan karakter khusus lainnya.
- Slug harus unik di seluruh undangan.
- Slug harus dikonversi ke huruf kecil.
- Spasi yang dimasukkan customer dapat otomatis diubah menjadi tanda hubung jika sistem menggunakan fitur auto-generate slug.

### Periksa seluruh bagian yang berkaitan

Jangan hanya memperbaiki validasi pada input form.

Audit juga:
- Validasi Laravel pada Request atau Controller.
- JavaScript validasi frontend.
- HTML input pattern.
- Model dan mutator jika ada.
- Database column.
- Unique constraint.
- Route parameter.
- Route model binding.
- Generate URL.
- Link preview.
- Link undangan publik.
- Link WhatsApp.
- Sistem pencarian undangan.

Pastikan route:

`/wedding/{slug}`

dapat menerima slug dengan tanda hubung.

Pastikan route publik tidak bertabrakan dengan route dashboard, admin, templates, dan route sistem lainnya.

Jangan menggunakan validasi slug yang hanya menerima karakter alfabet tanpa tanda hubung.

---

## 4. PENYESUAIAN DASHBOARD CUSTOMER

Hapus menu atau informasi yang berkaitan dengan paket dan langganan.

Ganti dengan informasi status undangan.

Pada daftar undangan customer, tampilkan:

- Nama pasangan.
- Template.
- Slug.
- Status undangan.
- Status pengajuan.
- Status pembayaran.
- Tanggal dibuat.
- Tanggal dipublikasikan.

Sediakan tombol sesuai kondisi:

**Jika masih Draft:**
- Edit Undangan.
- Preview.
- Ajukan Publikasi.

**Jika Menunggu Konfirmasi atau Menunggu Pembayaran:**
- Lihat Status.
- Hubungi Admin.
- Preview.

**Jika Menunggu Verifikasi:**
- Lihat Status.
- Hubungi Admin.
- Preview.

**Jika Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi tetapi belum dipublikasikan:**
- Lihat Status.
- Preview.
- Hubungi Admin.

**Jika Revisi:**
- Edit Undangan.
- Preview.
- Ajukan Kembali.

**Jika Dipublikasikan:**
- Lihat Undangan.
- Salin Link.
- Bagikan ke WhatsApp.

Tombol Bagikan ke WhatsApp dan Salin Link hanya aktif setelah undangan benar-benar dipublikasikan.

---

## 5. PENYESUAIAN DATABASE DAN KEAMANAN

Audit tabel yang berkaitan dengan:
- Weddings.
- Subscriptions.
- Payments.
- Users.
- Pengajuan publikasi.

Hapus atau nonaktifkan sistem paket yang tidak lagi digunakan dengan aman.

Jangan langsung menghapus tabel atau kolom yang masih memiliki relasi atau digunakan fitur lain.

Jika dibutuhkan, buat migration untuk menambahkan:
- Status pengajuan.
- Status pembayaran.
- Waktu pengajuan.
- Waktu konfirmasi pembayaran.
- Waktu publikasi.
- ID admin yang memverifikasi pembayaran.
- ID admin yang memublikasikan undangan.
- Catatan revisi.
- Riwayat perubahan status.

Gunakan transaksi database untuk perubahan status yang saling berkaitan.

Terapkan authorization di backend, bukan hanya menyembunyikan tombol di frontend.

Pastikan:
- Customer hanya dapat mengelola undangannya sendiri.
- Customer tidak dapat mengubah status pembayaran menjadi lunas.
- Customer tidak dapat mengubah status menjadi published.
- Hanya admin berwenang yang dapat memverifikasi pembayaran.
- Hanya admin berwenang yang dapat memublikasikan undangan.
- Undangan draft tidak dapat diakses publik.
- Undangan yang belum dipublikasikan tidak dapat dibagikan sebagai undangan aktif.

---

## 6. TESTING WAJIB

Setelah perbaikan, jalankan pengujian berikut.

### Pengujian sistem pembayaran dan publikasi

1. Customer dapat membuat undangan gratis.
2. Customer dapat menggunakan seluruh template.
3. Customer dapat mengedit semua informasi.
4. Customer dapat menyimpan draft.
5. Customer dapat mengajukan publikasi.
6. Admin dapat menerima pengajuan.
7. Admin dapat menghubungi customer melalui WhatsApp.
8. Admin dapat mengonfirmasi pembayaran.
9. Customer tidak dapat mengonfirmasi pembayaran sendiri.
10. Customer tidak dapat memublikasikan undangan.
11. Admin dapat memublikasikan undangan setelah pembayaran dikonfirmasi.
12. Undangan hanya dapat diakses publik setelah dipublikasikan.
13. Customer dapat membagikan undangan setelah publikasi.

### Pengujian slug

Uji slug berikut:

| Input | Hasil |
|---|---|
| andi-siti | Valid |
| syahron-maulana | Valid |
| andi-putri-2026 | Valid |
| andi--siti | Tidak valid |
| -andi-siti | Tidak valid |
| andi-siti- | Tidak valid |
| Andi-Siti | Dinormalisasi menjadi andi-siti |
| andi siti | Dinormalisasi menjadi andi-siti |
| andi@siti | Tidak valid |

Pastikan slug valid dapat menghasilkan URL publik dengan benar.

---

## 7. LAPORAN HASIL PERBAIKAN

Setelah selesai:

1. Jelaskan sistem paket apa saja yang sudah dihapus atau dinonaktifkan.
2. Jelaskan alur pengajuan dan publikasi yang berhasil dibuat.
3. Jelaskan perubahan pada dashboard customer.
4. Jelaskan perubahan pada dashboard admin.
5. Jelaskan perubahan database dan migration.
6. Jelaskan perbaikan validasi slug.
7. Sebutkan file yang dibuat dan dimodifikasi.
8. Tampilkan hasil pengujian.
9. Laporkan error yang masih ditemukan.

**Jangan hanya memberikan rekomendasi atau contoh kode. Lakukan perubahan langsung pada proyek yang sudah ada.**

Jangan merusak delapan desain template, sistem editor, RSVP, manajemen tamu, dan fitur lain yang sudah berfungsi.

Prioritas utama adalah mengimplementasikan sistem pengajuan publikasi dengan pembayaran manual melalui admin, kontrol publikasi sepenuhnya oleh admin, dan memperbaiki bug slug yang tidak menerima tanda hubung `-`.

# PROMPT PERBAIKAN SISTEM MARKAS PUNOKAWAN — WEDDING

Bertindaklah sebagai Senior Laravel Developer dan Software Architect.

Lakukan audit terhadap implementasi Markas Punokawan – Wedding yang sudah selesai dibuat. Saya menemukan beberapa ketidaksesuaian sistem dan bug yang harus diperbaiki.

**PENTING:**
- Jangan membangun ulang aplikasi dari awal.
- Jangan menghapus fitur yang sudah berjalan dengan baik.
- Jangan merusak desain delapan template yang sudah dibuat.
- Periksa struktur database, migration, model, controller, middleware, route, Blade, JavaScript, dan seluruh alur yang berkaitan sebelum melakukan perubahan.
- Fokus pada perbaikan sistem yang sudah ada.

---

## 1. HAPUS SISTEM PAKET DAN PENGGUNA GRATIS

Saya memutuskan untuk tidak menggunakan sistem paket berlangganan.

Hapus seluruh konsep:
- Paket Gratis.
- Paket Basic.
- Paket Premium.
- Subscription.
- Pembatasan fitur berdasarkan paket.
- Status berlangganan.
- Upgrade paket.
- Pembayaran otomatis.
- Payment gateway.
- Harga paket.

Semua customer mendapatkan hak akses yang sama.

### Aturan penggunaan customer

Setiap customer yang sudah memiliki akun dapat:

1. Membuat undangan tanpa batasan paket.
2. Memilih seluruh template yang tersedia.
3. Mengedit seluruh bagian undangan.
4. Mengganti desain kapan saja selama belum dipublikasikan.
5. Mengunggah foto.
6. Mengatur informasi pernikahan.
7. Mengelola daftar tamu.
8. Mengatur RSVP dan ucapan.
9. Melihat preview undangan secara keseluruhan.
10. Menyimpan perubahan sebagai draft.

**Tidak ada pembayaran untuk sekadar membuat dan mengedit undangan.**

Namun, customer tidak mempunyai hak untuk memublikasikan undangan sendiri.

---

## 2. SISTEM PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI KE ADMIN

Buat sistem pengajuan publikasi undangan.

Alur yang diinginkan:

CUSTOMER MEMBUAT UNDANGAN
↓
CUSTOMER MEMILIH TEMPLATE
↓
CUSTOMER MENGEDIT UNDANGAN
↓
CUSTOMER MELAKUKAN PREVIEW
↓
CUSTOMER MEMASTIKAN DESAIN SUDAH FINAL
↓
CUSTOMER MENEKAN TOMBOL AJUKAN KE ADMIN
↓
ADMIN MENERIMA PENGAJUAN
↓
CUSTOMER MELAKUKAN PEMBAYARAN MELALUI CHAT PRIBADI ADMIN
↓
ADMIN MEMERIKSA PEMBAYARAN
↓
ADMIN MENGONFIRMASI PEMBAYARAN
↓
ADMIN MELAKUKAN PUBLIKASI
↓
UNDANGAN ONLINE DAN DAPAT DIAKSES PUBLIK
↓
CUSTOMER DAPAT MEMBAGIKAN LINK MELALUI WHATSAPP

### A. Sisi customer

Tambahkan tombol:

**AJUKAN PUBLIKASI**

Tombol hanya muncul ketika undangan sudah memiliki informasi minimum yang diperlukan dan belum dipublikasikan.

Ketika ditekan:

- Tampilkan konfirmasi bahwa desain undangan sudah final.
- Berikan informasi bahwa pengajuan akan dikirim kepada admin.
- Berikan informasi bahwa pembayaran dilakukan secara manual melalui chat pribadi admin.
- Setelah dikonfirmasi, ubah status undangan menjadi menunggu konfirmasi admin.

Setelah pengajuan dikirim, tampilkan status yang jelas pada dashboard customer.

Status yang diperlukan:

| Status | Keterangan |
|---|---|
| Draft | Undangan sedang dibuat atau diedit |
| Menunggu Konfirmasi | Pengajuan sudah dikirim kepada admin |
| Menunggu Pembayaran | Admin sudah memberikan instruksi pembayaran |
| Menunggu Verifikasi | Customer menginformasikan bahwa pembayaran sudah dilakukan |
| Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi | Admin sudah memverifikasi pembayaran |
| Dipublikasikan | Admin sudah memublikasikan undangan |
| Revisi | Admin meminta customer memperbaiki undangan |

Jangan membuat status pembayaran dikonfirmasi secara otomatis.

### B. Sisi admin

Pada dashboard Super Admin Wedding, buat menu baru:

**PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI**

Admin dapat melihat:

- Nama customer.
- Nama pasangan.
- Judul undangan.
- Template yang digunakan.
- Link atau slug undangan.
- Tanggal pengajuan.
- Status pengajuan.
- Preview undangan.
- Status pembayaran.

Sediakan tindakan:

1. Lihat Detail.
2. Preview Undangan.
3. Hubungi Customer melalui WhatsApp.
4. Konfirmasi Instruksi Pembayaran.
5. Tandai Pembayaran Sudah Diterima.
6. Minta Revisi.
7. Publikasikan Undangan.

### C. Pembayaran manual

Tidak perlu membuat sistem pembayaran otomatis.

Customer melakukan pembayaran melalui komunikasi pribadi dengan admin.

Sediakan tombol WhatsApp yang mengarahkan customer kepada nomor WhatsApp resmi admin yang dikonfigurasi melalui pengaturan aplikasi.

Gunakan pesan otomatis yang berisi:
- Nama customer.
- Nama pasangan.
- ID undangan.
- Informasi pengajuan publikasi.

Nomor WhatsApp admin jangan di-hardcode di banyak file. Gunakan konfigurasi terpusat yang dapat diubah oleh Super Admin.

Admin hanya boleh mengubah status pembayaran menjadi terkonfirmasi setelah benar-benar memeriksa pembayaran.

### D. Publikasi hanya oleh admin

Ini merupakan aturan yang sangat penting.

**Customer tidak boleh mempunyai kemampuan untuk memublikasikan undangan sendiri, baik melalui dashboard, manipulasi URL, request langsung, maupun API.**

Publikasi hanya dapat dilakukan oleh akun Super Admin yang memiliki otorisasi.

Sebelum memublikasikan, sistem harus memeriksa:

- Undangan sudah diajukan.
- Pembayaran sudah dikonfirmasi admin.
- Data undangan sudah memenuhi persyaratan.
- Slug tersedia dan valid.
- Tidak ada masalah pada data undangan.

Setelah semua persyaratan terpenuhi, admin dapat menekan tombol:

**PUBLIKASIKAN UNDANGAN**

Setelah berhasil:
- Status undangan berubah menjadi Dipublikasikan.
- `published_at` diisi.
- Halaman publik undangan dapat diakses.
- Link undangan dapat dibagikan.
- Customer mendapatkan notifikasi bahwa undangannya sudah online.

Jangan mengizinkan customer mengubah status publikasi melalui request biasa.

### E. Pengeditan setelah pengajuan

Jika customer ingin mengubah desain atau isi undangan setelah mengajukan publikasi:

- Customer harus membatalkan pengajuan atau meminta revisi.
- Admin dapat mengembalikan status pengajuan menjadi Revisi.
- Setelah customer melakukan perubahan, customer harus mengajukan kembali.
- Jika desain berubah setelah pembayaran dikonfirmasi tetapi sebelum publikasi, admin harus memeriksa ulang hasil akhirnya.

Untuk undangan yang sudah dipublikasikan, jangan mengizinkan perubahan penting secara diam-diam. Gunakan mekanisme pengeditan dan penyimpanan perubahan yang tetap menjaga halaman publik tetap stabil sampai perubahan disetujui atau diterapkan.

---

## 3. PERBAIKI BUG SLUG / LINK UNDANGAN

Saat customer mengisi link undangan, sistem tidak mengizinkan penggunaan karakter tanda hubung `-`.

Ini merupakan bug yang harus diperbaiki.

Contoh slug yang harus diterima:

- andi-siti
- andi-putri
- syahron-maulana
- ahmad-fitria-2026
- undangan-pernikahan-andi-siti

Contoh URL:

`/wedding/andi-siti`

`/wedding/syahron-maulana`

### Aturan validasi slug

Gunakan format slug yang mendukung:

- Huruf kecil `a-z`.
- Angka `0-9`.
- Tanda hubung `-`.

Contoh pola regex:

`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`

Ketentuan:
- Slug tidak boleh diawali tanda hubung.
- Slug tidak boleh diakhiri tanda hubung.
- Tidak boleh terdapat tanda hubung berulang seperti `andi--siti`.
- Tidak boleh menggunakan spasi.
- Tidak boleh menggunakan karakter khusus lainnya.
- Slug harus unik di seluruh undangan.
- Slug harus dikonversi ke huruf kecil.
- Spasi yang dimasukkan customer dapat otomatis diubah menjadi tanda hubung jika sistem menggunakan fitur auto-generate slug.

### Periksa seluruh bagian yang berkaitan

Jangan hanya memperbaiki validasi pada input form.

Audit juga:
- Validasi Laravel pada Request atau Controller.
- JavaScript validasi frontend.
- HTML input pattern.
- Model dan mutator jika ada.
- Database column.
- Unique constraint.
- Route parameter.
- Route model binding.
- Generate URL.
- Link preview.
- Link undangan publik.
- Link WhatsApp.
- Sistem pencarian undangan.

Pastikan route:

`/wedding/{slug}`

dapat menerima slug dengan tanda hubung.

Pastikan route publik tidak bertabrakan dengan route dashboard, admin, templates, dan route sistem lainnya.

Jangan menggunakan validasi slug yang hanya menerima karakter alfabet tanpa tanda hubung.

---

## 4. PENYESUAIAN DASHBOARD CUSTOMER

Hapus menu atau informasi yang berkaitan dengan paket dan langganan.

Ganti dengan informasi status undangan.

Pada daftar undangan customer, tampilkan:

- Nama pasangan.
- Template.
- Slug.
- Status undangan.
- Status pengajuan.
- Status pembayaran.
- Tanggal dibuat.
- Tanggal dipublikasikan.

Sediakan tombol sesuai kondisi:

**Jika masih Draft:**
- Edit Undangan.
- Preview.
- Ajukan Publikasi.

**Jika Menunggu Konfirmasi atau Menunggu Pembayaran:**
- Lihat Status.
- Hubungi Admin.
- Preview.

**Jika Menunggu Verifikasi:**
- Lihat Status.
- Hubungi Admin.
- Preview.

**Jika Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi tetapi belum dipublikasikan:**
- Lihat Status.
- Preview.
- Hubungi Admin.

**Jika Revisi:**
- Edit Undangan.
- Preview.
- Ajukan Kembali.

**Jika Dipublikasikan:**
- Lihat Undangan.
- Salin Link.
- Bagikan ke WhatsApp.

Tombol Bagikan ke WhatsApp dan Salin Link hanya aktif setelah undangan benar-benar dipublikasikan.

---

## 5. PENYESUAIAN DATABASE DAN KEAMANAN

Audit tabel yang berkaitan dengan:
- Weddings.
- Subscriptions.
- Payments.
- Users.
- Pengajuan publikasi.

Hapus atau nonaktifkan sistem paket yang tidak lagi digunakan dengan aman.

Jangan langsung menghapus tabel atau kolom yang masih memiliki relasi atau digunakan fitur lain.

Jika dibutuhkan, buat migration untuk menambahkan:
- Status pengajuan.
- Status pembayaran.
- Waktu pengajuan.
- Waktu konfirmasi pembayaran.
- Waktu publikasi.
- ID admin yang memverifikasi pembayaran.
- ID admin yang memublikasikan undangan.
- Catatan revisi.
- Riwayat perubahan status.

Gunakan transaksi database untuk perubahan status yang saling berkaitan.

Terapkan authorization di backend, bukan hanya menyembunyikan tombol di frontend.

Pastikan:
- Customer hanya dapat mengelola undangannya sendiri.
- Customer tidak dapat mengubah status pembayaran menjadi lunas.
- Customer tidak dapat mengubah status menjadi published.
- Hanya admin berwenang yang dapat memverifikasi pembayaran.
- Hanya admin berwenang yang dapat memublikasikan undangan.
- Undangan draft tidak dapat diakses publik.
- Undangan yang belum dipublikasikan tidak dapat dibagikan sebagai undangan aktif.

---

## 6. TESTING WAJIB

Setelah perbaikan, jalankan pengujian berikut.

### Pengujian sistem pembayaran dan publikasi

1. Customer dapat membuat undangan gratis.
2. Customer dapat menggunakan seluruh template.
3. Customer dapat mengedit semua informasi.
4. Customer dapat menyimpan draft.
5. Customer dapat mengajukan publikasi.
6. Admin dapat menerima pengajuan.
7. Admin dapat menghubungi customer melalui WhatsApp.
8. Admin dapat mengonfirmasi pembayaran.
9. Customer tidak dapat mengonfirmasi pembayaran sendiri.
10. Customer tidak dapat memublikasikan undangan.
11. Admin dapat memublikasikan undangan setelah pembayaran dikonfirmasi.
12. Undangan hanya dapat diakses publik setelah dipublikasikan.
13. Customer dapat membagikan undangan setelah publikasi.

### Pengujian slug

Uji slug berikut:

| Input | Hasil |
|---|---|
| andi-siti | Valid |
| syahron-maulana | Valid |
| andi-putri-2026 | Valid |
| andi--siti | Tidak valid |
| -andi-siti | Tidak valid |
| andi-siti- | Tidak valid |
| Andi-Siti | Dinormalisasi menjadi andi-siti |
| andi siti | Dinormalisasi menjadi andi-siti |
| andi@siti | Tidak valid |

Pastikan slug valid dapat menghasilkan URL publik dengan benar.

---

## 7. LAPORAN HASIL PERBAIKAN

Setelah selesai:

1. Jelaskan sistem paket apa saja yang sudah dihapus atau dinonaktifkan.
2. Jelaskan alur pengajuan dan publikasi yang berhasil dibuat.
3. Jelaskan perubahan pada dashboard customer.
4. Jelaskan perubahan pada dashboard admin.
5. Jelaskan perubahan database dan migration.
6. Jelaskan perbaikan validasi slug.
7. Sebutkan file yang dibuat dan dimodifikasi.
8. Tampilkan hasil pengujian.
9. Laporkan error yang masih ditemukan.

**Jangan hanya memberikan rekomendasi atau contoh kode. Lakukan perubahan langsung pada proyek yang sudah ada.**

Jangan merusak delapan desain template, sistem editor, RSVP, manajemen tamu, dan fitur lain yang sudah berfungsi.

Prioritas utama adalah mengimplementasikan sistem pengajuan publikasi dengan pembayaran manual melalui admin, kontrol publikasi sepenuhnya oleh admin, dan memperbaiki bug slug yang tidak menerima tanda hubung `-`.

## Objective
- Build and now revise the isolated Wedding module for **Markas Punokawan** under `/wedding`, replacing package/subscription gating with admin-controlled publication approval and manual payment.

## Requirements
- Keep all Wedding URLs under `/wedding`; never take over `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/dashboard`, or other platform routes.
- Laravel 12, PHP 8.2+, MySQL, Blade, Tailwind, Alpine.js, Lucide, Eloquent; all UI/invitation content in Bahasa Indonesia.
- Preserve the 8 distinct templates (Melati, Senja, Lestari, Maharaja, Arum, Puspita, Asmara, Nirmala), editor, RSVP, guest management, and other working features.
- Remove all package/subscription concepts: Gratis/Basic/Premium, subscription status, feature limits, upgrades, automatic payments, payment gateway, package prices.
- All customers get full access: create unlimited invitations, use all templates, edit everything, change templates before publication, upload photos, manage guests/RSVP/wishes, preview, and save drafts.
- Customers cannot publish invitations themselves. Publication is Super Admin only, enforced server-side, not just by hiding buttons.
- Add customer **AJUKAN PUBLIKASI** flow with confirmation that the design is final, admin receives the submission, and manual payment is arranged through private admin chat.
- Required statuses: Draft, Menunggu Konfirmasi, Menunggu Pembayaran, Menunggu Verifikasi, Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi, Dipublikasikan, Revisi.
- Admin gets **PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI** menu showing customer, couple names, invitation title, template, slug/link, submission date, submission status, preview, payment status.
- Admin actions: detail, preview, WhatsApp customer, confirm payment instructions, mark payment received, request revision, publish invitation.
- Admin WhatsApp number must come from centralized editable settings, not hardcoded; automatic message must include customer name, couple names, invitation ID, and publication submission info.
- Admin may mark payment confirmed only after actually checking payment.
- Before publishing, admin system must verify submission exists, payment confirmed, data requirements met, slug valid/available, and no data problems.
- Customer edits after submission require cancelling/revision; after changes they must resubmit. Published invitations must not silently change public content.
- Slug must support lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens with pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`; reject leading/trailing/double hyphens and special characters; normalize uppercase and spaces to lowercase hyphenated; remain unique.
- Customer invitation list must show couple, template, slug, invitation status, submission status, payment status, created date, publication date, with state-specific actions.
- Copy/share WhatsApp buttons only active after actual publication.
- Do not state features are complete without tests.

## Decisions
- Existing partial project preserved; Wedding module lives in `resources/views/wedding` and `public/wedding-assets`.
- Root `/` remains the Markas Punokawan platform landing; Wedding begins at `/wedding`.
- Existing DB tables `packages`, `subscriptions`, and `payments` may remain physically for safety, but all package logic/UI/route usage must be removed or disabled.
- Use migration `2026_11_14_000002_add_publication_workflow_to_weddings.php` (already created) for `submission_status`, `payment_status`, `submitted_at`, `payment_confirmed_at`, `payment_verifier_id`, `publisher_id`, and `revision_notes`.
- Admin verification/publishing must use DB transactions and backend authorization.
- Current code already added many publication-related fields/views but is inconsistent and still references packages heavily.
- Tests use SQLite in-memory via `phpunit.xml`; MySQL is currently unavailable (`SQLSTATE[HY000] [2002] connection refused`).

## Work State
### Completed
- Full initial Wedding module: 8 templates, catalog/live preview, editor, guest management, RSVP/wishes, WhatsApp click-to-chat, customer/admin dashboards, landing/packages pages, auth, migrations, seeder, demo images.
- 72 tests previously passed; `npm run build` succeeded; `public/hot` removed so built assets are used.
- Fixed demo image URL resolution in `Wedding::assetUrl()` so `wedding-assets/...` paths use `asset()` and uploaded `wedding/...` paths use `/storage/...`.
- Changed editor preview labels to Indonesian (`Pratinjau`, `Pratinjau Langsung`); fixed RoleAccess test assertion.
- Created `README-WEDDING.md` documenting module, templates, features, demo accounts, install/test commands.
- Publication workflow migration created: `2026_11_14_000002_add_publication_workflow_to_weddings.php`.
- Some partial publication UI/status code already exists in `invitations/show`, admin dashboard, and `admin/weddings`, but is not consistently wired.

### Active
- Auditing
 all package/subscription usage and publication flow before implementing the requested overhaul.
- Identified major remaining package references in `User`, `InvitationController`, `GuestController`, `BroadcastController`, dashboard/admin controllers, landing/packages views, routes, tests, and seeder.
- Verified slug regex already supports hyphens in backend and route constraints, but backend normalization for uppercase/spaces and frontend behavior still need alignment with required test table.
- `InvitationController::publish()` currently still allows customers to publish; must be removed/blocked.
- `InvitationController::submitPublication()` currently just sets `pending_payment`; must be replaced with proper submission status flow.
- Admin `WeddingController::status()` and `approvePublication()` allow direct publication without verifying payment/submission consistently; must be hardened.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/show.blade.php` references nonexistent `App\Models\Setting`; use `WeddingSetting` instead.
- Dashboard/layout still contains subscription nav link and package-related messaging.
- Landing page and `/wedding/paket` still show packages/prices.

### Blocked
- MySQL is not running, so `php artisan migrate:status` fails. Use SQLite or tests for validation until MySQL is available.

## Next Move
1. Finish audit of remaining package-related code and publication views/routes.
2. Implement publication status constants, helpers, casts, and DB workflow in `Wedding` model.
3. Remove/disable package gating from `InvitationController`, `GuestController`, `BroadcastController`, dashboards, landing, admin, routes, seeder, and tests.
4. Implement customer submit-publication flow with required minimum data checks, final-design confirmation, status transitions, and resubmission after revision.
5. Implement admin **PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI** page/controller with detail, preview, WhatsApp customer, payment instruction, confirm payment, revision, and publish actions.
6. Enforce backend authorization: customers cannot publish or confirm payment; only super admin can publish after payment confirmation and validation.
7. Add centralized admin WhatsApp setting and use it in customer/admin WhatsApp links.
8. Fix slug normalization backend/frontend to satisfy all required valid/invalid cases, and verify route/public URL generation.
9. Update customer invitation list and detail views with required statuses/actions.
10. Update database migration as needed, run tests in SQLite, and add required publication/slug tests.
11. Run `npm run build`, browser-check templates/dashboards, and write the final repair report.

## Relevant Files
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/InvitationController.php`: core create/edit/update/publish/submit logic; still package-coupled and customer-publishable.
- `app/Models/Wedding.php`: statuses/helpers/casts; needs publication workflow fields.
- `app/Models/User.php`: still has `activePackage()`, subscriptions/payments relations.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/GuestController.php`: still enforces package limits/WhatsApp/export restrictions.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/Admin/WeddingController.php`: admin status/publication logic; needs hardening.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/Admin/DashboardController.php`: still uses `Payment`/revenue/package.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/DashboardController.php`: passes `package`.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/BroadcastController.php`: package-gated WhatsApp.
- `routes/wedding.php`: package/subscription routes and publish/submit routes.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/show.blade.php`: partial publication UI; wrong `Setting` model reference.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/index.blade.php`: package actions/status UI.
- `resources/views/wedding/layouts/dashboard.blade.php`: subscription nav and full-access badge.
- `resources/views/wedding/public/landing.blade.php`: packages/pricing section.
- `database/migrations/2026_11_14_000002_add_publication_workflow_to_weddings.php`: existing workflow columns.
- `tests/Feature/InvitationFlowTest.php`, `tests/Feature/GuestManagementTest.php`, `tests/Concerns/CreatesWeddings.php`: package-era tests needing rewrite.
- `config/wedding.php`: reserved slugs/templates/limits; consider centralized admin WhatsApp setting here or `WeddingSetting`.

## Important Context
- Project root: `C:\Users\admin\Documents\Codex\2026-11-11\master-prompt-codex-platform-saas-undangan`; ignore nested duplicate project directory.
- Dev server previously on `http://127.0.0.1:8020`; MySQL currently refuses connections on `127.0.0.1:3306` database `ujicoba`.
- `php artisan test` uses SQLite in-memory and previously passed 72 tests.
- `public/wedding` must not exist; assets live in `public/wedding-assets`.
- Demo customer `demo@markaspunokawan.test` / `demo12345`; admin `admin@markaspunokawan.test` / `ganti-kata-sandi-ini`.
- `WeddingSetting` exists with `get()`/`put()`; `App\Models\Setting` does not exist.
- Slug backend regex already `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` in `InvitationController` and route constraints.
- Need to normalize only uppercase and spaces for backend acceptance; do not collapse `andi--siti`, `-andi-siti`, `andi-siti-`, or `andi@siti` into valid slugs.
- No git repo; all changes are uncommitted filesystem changes.
- `public/hot` removed; Vite production build exists in `public/build`.

## Objective
- Revise the isolated Wedding module for **Markas Punokawan** under `/wedding`: remove all package/subscription gating, add admin-controlled publication approval with manual payment, and fix slug validation for hyphens.

## Requirements
- Keep all Wedding URLs under `/wedding`; never take over `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/dashboard`, or other platform routes.
- Laravel 12, PHP 8.2+, MySQL, Blade, Tailwind, Alpine.js, Lucide, Eloquent; all UI/invitation content in Bahasa Indonesia.
- Preserve the 8 templates (Melati, Senja, Lestari, Maharaja, Arum, Puspita, Asmara, Nirmala), editor, RSVP, guest management, and other working features.
- Remove all package/subscription concepts: Gratis/Basic/Premium, subscription status, feature limits, upgrades, automatic payments, payment gateway, package prices.
- All customers get full access: unlimited invitations, all templates, full editing, template changes before publication, photo uploads, guest/RSVP/wish management, preview, drafts.
- Customers cannot publish; publication is Super Admin only, enforced server-side, not just hidden buttons.
- Add customer **AJUKAN PUBLIKASI** flow with confirmation that design is final, admin receives submission, manual payment arranged via private admin chat.
- Required statuses: Draft, Menunggu Konfirmasi, Menunggu Pembayaran, Menunggu Verifikasi, Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi, Dipublikasikan, Revisi.
- Admin gets **PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI** menu showing customer, couple names, invitation title, template, slug/link, submission date, submission status, preview, payment status.
- Admin actions: detail, preview, WhatsApp customer, confirm payment instructions, mark payment received, request revision, publish.
- Admin WhatsApp number from centralized editable settings, not hardcoded; automatic message includes customer name, couple names, invitation ID, submission info.
- Admin may mark payment confirmed only after actually checking payment.
- Before publishing, verify submission exists, payment confirmed, data requirements met, slug valid/available, no data problems.
- Customer edits after submission require cancelling/revision; after changes resubmit. Published invitations must not silently change public content.
- Slug must support lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`; reject leading/trailing/double hyphens and special characters; normalize uppercase/spaces to lowercase hyphenated; remain unique.
- Customer invitation list must show couple, template, slug, invitation status, submission status, payment status, created date, publication date, with state-specific actions.
- Copy/share WhatsApp buttons active only after actual publication.
- Run the required payment/publication and slug test matrix; do not claim completion without tests.
- Do not rebuild from scratch, do not delete working features, do not break template designs; inspect DB/migrations/models/controllers/middleware/routes/Blade/JS before changing.

## Decisions
- Existing partial project preserved; Wedding module lives in `resources/views/wedding` and `public/wedding-assets`.
- Root `/` remains the Markas Punokawan platform landing; Wedding begins at `/wedding`.
- DB tables `packages`, `subscriptions`, `payments` may remain physically for safety, but package logic/UI/route usage must be removed or disabled.
- Use migration `2026_11_14_000002_add_publication_workflow_to_weddings.php` (already created) for `submission_status`, `payment_status`, `submitted_at`, `payment_confirmed_at`, `payment_verifier_id`, `publisher_id`, `revision_notes`.
- Admin verification/publishing must use DB transactions and backend authorization.
- Customer must not publish or confirm payment, even via direct URL/request/API.
- Use `WeddingSetting` for centralized settings; `App\Models\Setting` does not exist.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full initial Wedding module: 8 templates, catalog/live preview, editor, guest management, RSVP/wishes, WhatsApp click-to-chat, customer/admin dashboards, landing/packages pages, auth, migrations, seeder, demo images.
- 72 tests previously passed; `npm run build` succeeded; `public/hot` removed so built assets are used.
- Fixed demo image URL resolution in `Wedding::assetUrl()`; editor preview labels changed to Indonesian; `RoleAccessTest` assertion fixed.
- Created `README-WEDDING.md`.
- Created publication workflow migration `2026_11_14_000002_add_publication_workflow_to_weddings.php`.
- Audit of package usage and publication flow largely complete across models, controllers, routes, views, tests, and seeder.
- Verified slug regex already supports hyphens in backend validation and route constraints; backend normalization of uppercase/spaces still needed.

### Active
- Implementing the requested overhaul: removing package gating and building the submit → payment → verify → publish workflow.
- `InvitationController::publish()` still allows customers to publish; must be removed/blocked.
- `InvitationController::submitPublication()` currently sets `status = pending_payment`; must use proper submission/payment status flow.
- Admin `WeddingController::status()` / `approvePublication()` allow direct publication without payment/submission checks; must be hardened with transactions.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/show.blade.php` references nonexistent `App\Models\Setting`; use `WeddingSetting`.
- Dashboard/layout still contains subscription nav link and package-related messaging.
- Landing page and `/wedding/paket` still show packages/prices.
- Remaining package references identified in: `User`, `InvitationController`, `GuestController`, `BroadcastController`, `DashboardController` (customer and admin), `LandingController`, `PackagePageController`, `AccountController`, `Admin\CustomerController`, `Admin\DashboardController`, routes, seeder, tests.
- Package-era tests still need rewriting: `tests/Feature/InvitationFlowTest.php`, `GuestManagementTest.php`, `PublicationWorkflowTest.php`, `tests/Concerns/CreatesWeddings.php`.

### Blocked
- MySQL unavailable (`SQLSTATE[HY000] [2002] connection refused` on `127.0.0.1:3306` database `ujicoba`); use SQLite in-memory via tests for validation until MySQL is available.

## Next Move
1. Add publication status constants, helpers, casts, and DB workflow methods to `Wedding` model.
2. Remove package gating from `InvitationController`, `GuestController`, `BroadcastController`, customer/admin dashboards, account, landing, admin customer views, routes, seeder, and tests.
3. Implement customer submit-publication flow: minimum-data checks, final-design confirmation, status transitions, resubmission after revision.
4. Implement admin **PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI** page/controller with detail, preview, WhatsApp customer, payment instruction, confirm payment, revision, publish.
5. Enforce backend authorization: customers cannot publish or confirm payment; only super admin can publish after verification.
6. Add centralized admin WhatsApp setting and reusable helper for WhatsApp links/messages.
7. Fix slug normalization backend/frontend to satisfy all valid/invalid cases and public URL generation.
8. Update customer invitation list/detail views with required statuses and state-specific actions; enable copy/share only after publication.
9. Update migration as needed; run SQLite tests including required publication and slug matrix.
10. Run `npm run build`, browser-check templates/dashboards, and write final repair report.

## Relevant Files
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/InvitationController.php`: core create/edit/update/publish/submit logic; still package-coupled and customer-publishable.
- `app/Models/Wedding.php`: statuses/helpers/casts; needs publication workflow fields.
- `app/Models/User.php`: still has `subscriptions`/`payments`/`activePackage()`.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/GuestController.php`: still enforces package limits/WhatsApp/export restrictions.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/BroadcastController.php`: package-gated WhatsApp.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/Admin/WeddingController.php`: admin status/publication logic; needs hardening.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/Admin/DashboardController.php`: still uses `Payment`/revenue/package.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/DashboardController.php`: passes `package`.
- `routes/wedding.php`: package/subscription routes and publish/submit routes.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/index.blade.php`: package actions/status UI.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/show.blade.php`: partial publication UI; wrong `Setting` model reference.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/edit.blade.php`: customer publish button/JS and package photo/music gating.
- `resources/views/wedding/layouts/dashboard.blade.php`: subscription nav and full-access badge.
- `resources/views/wedding/public/landing.blade.php`: packages/pricing section.
- `tests/Concerns/CreatesWeddings.php` and `tests/Feature/{InvitationFlowTest,GuestManagementTest,PublicationWorkflowTest}.php`: package-era tests needing rewrite.

## Important Context
- Project root: `C:\Users\admin\Documents\Codex\2026-11-11\master-prompt-codex-platform-saas-undangan`; ignore nested duplicate project directory.
- Dev server previously on `http://127.0.0.1:8020`.
- `php artisan test` uses SQLite in-memory.
- `public/wedding` must not exist; assets live in `public/wedding-assets`.
- Demo customer `demo@markaspunokawan.test` / `demo12345`; admin `admin@markaspunokawan.test` / `ganti-kata-sandi-ini`.
- `WeddingSetting` has static `get()`/`put()`.
- Slug backend regex is already `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` in `InvitationController` and route constraints.
- Normalize only uppercase and spaces for backend acceptance; reject `andi--siti`, `-andi-siti`, `andi-siti-`, `andi@siti`.
- No git repo; all changes are uncommitted filesystem changes.
- `public/build` exists from a prior Vite production build.

## Objective
- Revise the isolated Wedding module for **Markas Punokawan** under `/wedding`: remove all package/subscription gating, add admin-controlled publication approval with manual payment, and fix slug validation for hyphens.

## Requirements
- Keep all Wedding URLs under `/wedding`; never take over `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/dashboard`, or other platform routes.
- Laravel 12, PHP 8.2+, MySQL, Blade, Tailwind, Alpine.js, Lucide, Eloquent; all UI/invitation content in Bahasa Indonesia.
- Preserve the 8 templates (Melati, Senja, Lestari, Maharaja, Arum, Puspita, Asmara, Nirmala), editor, RSVP, guest management, and other working features.
- Remove all package/subscription concepts: Gratis/Basic/Premium, subscription status, feature limits, upgrades, automatic payments, payment gateway, package prices.
- All customers get full access: unlimited invitations, all templates, full editing, template changes before publication, photo uploads, guest/RSVP/wish management, preview, drafts.
- Customers cannot publish; publication is Super Admin only, enforced server-side, not just hidden buttons.
- Add customer **AJUKAN PUBLIKASI** flow with confirmation that design is final, admin receives submission, manual payment arranged via private admin chat.
- Required statuses: Draft, Menunggu Konfirmasi, Menunggu Pembayaran, Menunggu Verifikasi, Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi, Dipublikasikan, Revisi.
- Admin gets **PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI** menu showing customer, couple names, invitation title, template, slug/link, submission date, submission status, preview, payment status.
- Admin actions: detail, preview, WhatsApp customer, confirm payment instructions, mark payment received, request revision, publish.
- Admin WhatsApp number from centralized editable settings, not hardcoded; automatic message includes customer name, couple names, invitation ID, submission info.
- Admin may mark payment confirmed only after actually checking payment.
- Before publishing, verify submission exists, payment confirmed, data requirements met, slug valid/available, no data problems.
- Customer edits after submission require cancelling/revision; after changes resubmit. Published invitations must not silently change public content.
- Slug must support lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`; reject leading/trailing/double hyphens and special characters; normalize uppercase/spaces to lowercase hyphenated; remain unique.
- Customer invitation list must show couple, template, slug, invitation status, submission status, payment status, created date, publication date, with state-specific actions.
- Copy/share WhatsApp buttons active only after actual publication.
- Run the required payment/publication and slug test matrix; do not claim completion without tests.
- Do not rebuild from scratch, do not delete working features, do not break template designs; inspect DB/migrations/models/controllers/middleware/routes/Blade/JS before changing.

## Decisions
- Existing partial project preserved; Wedding module lives in `resources/views/wedding` and `public/wedding-assets`.
- Root `/` remains the Markas Punokawan platform landing; Wedding begins at `/wedding`.
- DB tables `packages`, `subscriptions`, `payments` may remain physically for safety, but package logic/UI/route usage must be removed or disabled.
- Use migration `2026_11_14_000002_add_publication_workflow_to_weddings.php` (already created) for `submission_status`, `payment_status`, `submitted_at`, `payment_confirmed_at`, `payment_verifier_id`, `publisher_id`, `revision_notes`.
- Admin verification/publishing must use DB transactions and backend authorization.
- Customer must not publish or confirm payment, even via direct URL/request/API.
- Use `WeddingSetting` for centralized settings; `App\Models\Setting` does not exist.
- Existing `Wedding::STATUS_DRAFT`/`STATUS_PUBLISHED` constants stay; add submission/payment status constants and helpers.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full initial Wedding module: 8 templates, catalog/live preview, editor, guest management, RSVP/wishes, WhatsApp click-to-chat, customer/admin dashboards, landing/packages pages, auth, migrations, seeder, demo images.
- 72 tests previously passed; `npm run build` succeeded; `public/hot` removed so built assets are used.
- Fixed demo image URL resolution in `Wedding::assetUrl()`; editor preview labels changed to Indonesian; `RoleAccessTest` assertion fixed.
- Created `README-WEDDING.md`.
- Created publication workflow migration `2026_11_14_000002_add_publication_workflow_to_weddings.php`.
- Audit confirmed exact package coupling and publication gaps across models, controllers, routes, views, tests, and seeder (details in Active).
- Confirmed slug regex already supports hyphens in backend validation and route constraints; backend normalization of uppercase/spaces still needed.

### Active
- Implementing the requested overhaul: removing package gating and building the submit → payment → verify → publish workflow.
- `InvitationController::publish()` still allows customers to publish; must be removed/blocked.
- `InvitationController::submitPublication()` currently sets `status = pending_payment`; must use proper submission/payment status flow.
- Admin `WeddingController::status()` / `approvePublication()` allow direct publication without payment/submission checks; must be hardened with transactions.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/show.blade.php` references nonexistent `App\Models\Setting`; use `WeddingSetting`.
- Dashboard/layout still contains subscription nav link and package-related messaging.
- Landing page and `/wedding/paket` still show packages/prices.
- Remaining package references confirmed in: `User` (`activePackage()`, subscriptions/payments), `InvitationController`, `GuestController` (limits/WhatsApp/export), `BroadcastController`, `DashboardController` (customer, passes `package`), `Admin\DashboardController` (`Payment` revenue), `LandingController`, `PackagePageController`, `AccountController`, `Admin\CustomerController` (`withCount('payments')`), routes, seeder, tests.
- `Admin\SettingController::KEYS` currently has `support_whatsapp`, `support_email`, `manual_payment_note`, `wish_moderation`, `default_quota`; needs a dedicated admin-publication WhatsApp setting and quota logic removal.
- Package-era tests still need rewriting: `tests/Feature/InvitationFlowTest.php`, `GuestManagementTest.php`, `PublicationWorkflowTest.php`, `tests/Concerns/CreatesWeddings.php` (has `makePackage`).

### Blocked
- MySQL unavailable (`SQLSTATE[HY000] [2002] connection refused` on `127.0.0.1:3306` database `ujicoba`); use SQLite in-memory tests for validation until MySQL is available.

## Next Move
1. Add publication status constants, helpers, casts, and DB workflow methods to `Wedding` model.
2. Remove package gating from `InvitationController`, `GuestController`, `BroadcastController`, customer/admin dashboards, account, landing, admin customer views, routes, seeder, and tests.
3. Implement customer submit-publication flow: minimum-data checks, final-design confirmation, status transitions, resubmission after revision.
4. Implement admin **PENGAJUAN PUBLIKASI** page/controller with detail, preview, WhatsApp customer, payment instruction, confirm payment, revision, publish.
5. Enforce backend authorization: customers cannot publish or confirm payment; only super admin can publish after verification.
6. Add centralized admin WhatsApp setting and reusable helper for WhatsApp links/messages.
7. Fix slug normalization backend/frontend to satisfy all valid/invalid cases and public URL generation.
8. Update customer invitation list/detail views with required statuses and state-specific actions; enable copy/share only after publication.
9. Update migration as needed; run SQLite tests including required publication and slug matrix.
10. Run `npm run build`, browser-check templates/dashboards, and write final repair report.

## Relevant Files
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/InvitationController.php`: core create/edit/update/publish/submit logic; still package-coupled and customer-publishable.
- `app/Models/Wedding.php`: statuses/helpers/casts; needs publication workflow fields.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/Admin/WeddingController.php`: admin status/publication logic; needs hardening.
- `routes/wedding.php`: package/subscription routes and publish/submit routes.
- `app/Models/User.php`: still has `subscriptions`/`payments`/`activePackage()`.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/show.blade.php`: partial publication UI; wrong `Setting` model reference.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/index.blade.php`: package actions and status UI.
- `resources/views/wedding/invitations/edit.blade.php`: customer publish button/JS and package photo/music gating.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/Admin/SettingController.php`: centralized settings keys/defaults incl. `default_quota`.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/GuestController.php`: package limits/WhatsApp/export restrictions.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/BroadcastController.php`: package-gated WhatsApp.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Wedding/Admin/DashboardController.php`: uses `Payment`/revenue/package.
- `resources/views/wedding/public/landing.blade.php`: packages/pricing section (also `public/packages.blade.php`).
- `tests/Concerns/CreatesWeddings.php`: package-era helpers (`makePackage`) to rewrite.
- `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php`: seeds packages/subscriptions; needs package removal.

## Important Context
- Project root: `C:\Users\admin\Documents\Codex\2026-11-11\master-prompt-codex-platform-saas-undangan`; ignore nested duplicate project directory.
- Dev server previously on `http://127.0.0.1:8020`.
- `php artisan test` uses SQLite in-memory.
- `public/wedding` must not exist; assets live in `public/wedding-assets`.
- Demo customer `demo@markaspunokawan.test` / `demo12345`; admin `admin@markaspunokawan.test` / `ganti-kata-sandi-ini`.
- `WeddingSetting` has static `get()`/`put()`; no `App\Models\Setting`.
- Slug backend regex is already `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` in `InvitationController` and route constraints.
- Normalize only uppercase and spaces for backend acceptance; reject `andi--siti`, `-andi-siti`, `andi-siti-`, `andi@siti`.
- No git repo; all changes are uncommitted filesystem changes.
- `public/build` exists from a prior Vite production build.

### Wedding model publication workflow

Statuses:
- `status` (web/public status): `draft`, `published` (keep existing). 
- `submission_status`: draft, menunggu_konfirmasi, menunggu_pembayaran, menunggu_verifikasi, pembayaran_dikonfirmasi, dipublikasikan, revisi
- `payment_status`: belum_bayar, menunggu_verifikasi, dikonfirmasi

Wait, the required statuses list: Draft, Menunggu Konfirmasi, Menunggu Pembayaran, Menunggu Verifikasi, Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi, Dipublikasikan, Revisi.

Let me define submission_status constants:
- SUBMISSION_DRAFT = 'draft'
- SUBMISSION_WAITING_CONFIRMATION = 'menunggu_konfirmasi'
- SUBMISSION_WAITING_PAYMENT = 'menunggu_pembayaran'
- SUBMISSION_WAITING_VERIFICATION = 'menunggu_verifikasi'
- SUBMISSION_PAYMENT_CONFIRMED = 'pembayaran_dikonfirmasi'
- SUBMISSION_PUBLISHED = 'dipublikasikan'
- SUBMISSION_REVISION = 'revisi'

payment_status:
- PAYMENT_UNPAID = 'belum_bayar'
- PAYMENT_WAITING_VERIFICATION = 'menunggu_verifikasi'
- PAYMENT_CONFIRMED = 'dikonfirmasi'

Flow:
1. Customer in editor clicks "Ajukan Publikasi" → confirm dialog "desain final". → server: validate minimum data (groom/bride names, at least one event, slug valid). Sets submission_status = menunggu_konfirmasi, submitted_at = now. Status stays draft. Admin notified.
2. Admin sees submission. Admin confirms payment instructions → submission_status = menunggu_pembayaran (admin contacts customer via WhatsApp with payment instructions). Actually requirement: "Admin actions: detail, preview, WhatsApp customer, confirm payment instructions, mark payment received, request revision, publish."

So "confirm payment instructions" = admin has sent payment info → sets submission_status = menunggu_pembayaran. Hmm, but there's also "Menunggu Konfirmasi" which is initial. Let me map:
- Customer submits → Menunggu Konfirmasi (waiting for admin to review/confirm)
- Admin confirms and sends payment instructions → Menunggu Pembayaran
- Customer pays (manual via chat) and admin marks... Actually "Menunggu Verifikasi" = waiting for admin to verify payment (customer claims paid). Admin marks payment received → Pembayaran Dikonfirmasi.
- Admin publishes → Dipublikasikan.
- Admin requests revision → Revisi.

The requirement says admin "mark payment received" only after actually checking payment. And "Menunggu Verifikasi" is a status. So flow:
- menunggu_konfirmasi (customer submitted, admin hasn't reviewed)
- menunggu_pembayaran (admin confirmed, sent payment instructions)
- menunggu_verifikasi (customer says they paid / admin awaiting verification) — how does it get here? Perhaps admin action "konfirmasi instruksi pembayaran" moves to menunggu_pembayaran, and then when payment is claimed... Actually let me make it: Admin "Tandai Menunggu Verifikasi" not needed. Let me have:
  - Admin action: "Kirim Instruksi Pembayaran" → menunggu_pembayaran + WhatsApp message.
  - Admin action: "Verifikasi Pembayaran Diterima" → payment_status = dikonfirmasi, submission_status = pembayaran_dikonfirmasi. (This is only allowed when admin confirms they've checked payment.)
  - Admin action: "Publikasikan" → status = published, submission_status = dipublikasikan.
  - Admin action: "Minta Revisi" → submission_status = revisi + revision_notes.

Where does menunggu_verifikasi come in? Perhaps customer can indicate they've paid → submission_status = menunggu_verifikasi. Let me add a customer action "Saya sudah bayar / konfirmasi pembayaran" after menunggu_pembayaran which sets menunggu_verifikasi. That gives the customer a way to signal. Requirement says customer "AJUKAN PUBLIKASI" flow with manual payment arranged via private admin chat. It doesn't explicitly require a "saya sudah bayar" button but the status Menunggu Verifikasi must exist. I'll add a customer action `konfirmasiPembayaran` (customer claims paid) → menunggu_verifikasi. That's reasonable and server-side safe (doesn't confirm payment).

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Models\Wedding;
use App\Models\WeddingSetting;

/**
 * Nomor WhatsApp admin terpusat (diatur di Pengaturan admin), bukan hardcoded.
 * Dipakai untuk konfirmasi pembayaran manual dan notifikasi pengajuan publikasi.
 */
class AdminWhatsApp
{
    public const SETTING_KEY = 'admin_whatsapp';

    public static function number(): string
    {
        $raw = WeddingSetting::get(self::SETTING_KEY, config('wedding.admin_whatsapp'));

        return preg_replace('/\D+/', '', (string) $raw) ?: '';
    }

    public static function url(string $message): string
    {
        return 'https://wa.me/'.self::number().'?text='.rawurlencode($message);
    }

    /** Pesan otomatis ke admin saat customer mengajukan publikasi. */
    public static function publicationMessage(Wedding $wedding): string
    {
        $customer = $wedding->user;

        return implode("\n", [
            'Halo Admin Markas Punokawan, saya ingin mengajukan publikasi undangan pernikahan.',
            '',
            'Nama customer: '.($customer?->name ?? '-'),
            'Nama mempelai: '.$wedding->coupleNames(),
            'ID undangan: #'.$wedding->id,
            'Judul undangan: '.($wedding->cover_caption ?: $wedding->coupleNames()),
            'Desain: '.($wedding->template?->name ?? '-'),
            'Alamat undangan: /wedding/'.$wedding->slug,
            'Waktu pengajuan: '.now()->translatedFormat('d F Y H:i'),
            '',
            'Mohon informasi pembayaran manual dan langkah selanjutnya. Terima kasih.',
        ]);
    }

    /** Pesan admin ke customer (tombol "WhatsApp Customer"). */
    public static function customerUrl(Wedding $wedding, string $message): string
    {
        $phone = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', (string) $wedding->user?->phone) ?: '';

        return 'https://wa.me/'.$phone.'?text='.rawurlencode($message);
    }
}

            if ($isAutosave) {
                return response()->json(['ok' => false, 'message' => $message], 423);

            return back()->withErrors(['publish' => $message]);
        }

        $rules = [
            'groom_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'groom_nickname' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:40'],
            'groom_father' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:80'],

            'bride_father' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'bride_mother' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'bride_instagram' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'event_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'language_style' => ['required', Rule::in(array_keys(config('wedding.language_styles')))],
            'opening_text' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:3000'],
            'closing_text' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:3000'],
            'quote_key' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:40'],
            'quote_text' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1200'],
            'quote_source' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'music_title' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'dress_code' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'hashtag' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'live_stream_url' => ['nullable', 'url', 'max:500'],
            'cover_caption' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:160'],
            'cover_photo' => ['nullable', 'image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp', 'max:'.config('wedding.limits.image_kb')],
            'groom_photo' => ['nullable', 'image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp', 'max:'.config('wedding.limits.image_kb')],
            'bride_photo' => ['nullable', 'image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp', 'max:'.config('wedding.limits.image_kb')],
            'music' => ['nullable', 'file', 'mimes:mp3,wav,m4a,ogg', 'max:'.config('wedding.limits.audio_kb')],
            'sections' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'sections.*' => ['boolean'],
            'events' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:12'],
            'events.*.id' => ['nullable', 'integer'],
            'events.*.name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'events.*.event_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'events.*.start_time' => ['nullable', 'date_format:H:i'],
            'events.*.end_time' => ['nullable', 'date_format:H:i'],
            'events.*.venue_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'events.*.address' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
            'events.*.maps_url' => ['nullable', 'url', 'max:500'],
            'stories' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:12'],
            'stories.*.id' => ['nullable', 'integer'],
            'stories.*.title' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'stories.*.story_date' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:40'],
            'stories.*.body' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
            'gifts' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:6'],
            'gifts.*.id' => ['nullable', 'integer'],
            'gifts.*.bank_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'gifts.*.account_number' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:40'],
            'gifts.*.account_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'photos' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:20'],
            'photos.*' => ['image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp', 'max:'.config('wedding.limits.image_kb')],
            'remove_photos' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'remove_photos.*' => ['integer'],
        ];

        $data = $request->validate($rules);

        $wasAwaiting = $wedding->hasActiveSubmission();

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $wedding, $data) {
            $files = [
                'cover_photo' => 'cover',
                'groom_photo' => 'mempelai',
                'bride_photo' => 'mempelai',
            ];

            foreach ($files as $field => $folder) {
                if ($request->hasFile($field)) {
                    $old = $wedding->{$field};
                    $wedding->{$field} = $request->file($field)->store('wedding/'.$wedding->id.'/'.$folder, 'public');

                $this->deleteStoredFile($wedding->music_path);

            $sections = config('wedding.default_sections');
            foreach (array_keys($sections) as $key) {
                $sections[$key] = (bool) ($data['sections'][$key] ?? false);

            $wedding->fill(collect($data)->except([
                'sections', 'events', 'stories', 'gifts', 'photos', 'remove_photos', 'music', 'cover_photo',

            $this->syncPhotos($request, $wedding);

            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('wedding.invitations.edit', $wedding)
            ->with('status', 'Undangan berhasil diperbarui.');
    }
